jobs.title: Project Manager, Social Impact
jobs.description:
Location: Remote - United States
Base Pay: $63500.0 - $72000.0 / Year
Job Category: Project Management
Employee Type: Full Time Exempt
Required Degree: 4 Year Degree
Manage Others: No
Minimum Experience: 5 Years

Brief Description

The American Diabetes Association (ADA) is seeking a Project Manager to join our Program Management Office. The Project Manager has overall responsibility for managing scope, budgets, timelines, project teams, stakeholders, vendors, and contractual deliverables across multiple projects that improve the lives of people living with diabetes. Reporting to the Program Director, this role supports the PMO in standardizing project management processes (with a focus on efficiency), ensuring strategic alignment and effective program delivery, and fostering collaboration across teams. The Project Manager will support ADA mission-driven success on PMO initiatives and programs while promoting accountability and impact.

Responsibilities

Leads cross-functional teams to deliver projects on time and within budget
Aligns resources to accomplish project tasks and key milestones with clear accountability for project deliverables
Communicates and collaborates with development and marketing teams to provide training and information required to promote and seek funding for new projects, programs, and systems.
Directs the work of a project team with overall responsibility for managing scope, budget, timeline, staffing and stakeholders, vendors, and contractual deliverables.
Accountable for project deliverables, overall project success, and supporting contract renewals to expand ADA’s offerings.
Serves as a liaison between internal and external stakeholders, volunteers, customers, and vendors.
Maintains process documentation and identifies opportunities for continuous improvement for all organization initiatives.
Facilitates quality management and change management techniques for project management.
Effectively estimates and plans project resources, schedules, and budgets.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required
Minimum expected years of relevant experience: 5 years in project management and/or delivery of programs, products, or services
Project Management Professional (PMP)® certification is preferred
Understanding of project management methodologies, such as PMBOK
Demonstrated proficiency in project management software (e.g. MS Project or Smartsheets)

Skills

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
Strong sense of urgency
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Ability to form and lead high-performing teams
Critical thinking and the ability to manage complex projects
Exceptional problem-solving skills
Strong change management skills
Demonstrates a high level of personal accountability and holds others accountable for results
Fosters collaboration and cooperation to deliver results
Strong planning, organization, and attention to detail
Good negotiation skills
Ability to prioritize, multitask, and work independently to manage multiple concurrent projects

Why Work Here

Benefits

The American Diabetes Association ® (ADA) offers a rewarding career working for one of the premier voluntary health organizations in the world supporting people living with diabetes and/or obesity. Our employees consistently say that our mission, culture, work-life balance, and total rewards package are what they like most about working at the ADA. benefits and our culture:

Industry competitive base pay. Base offers are determined by several factors including but not limited to your relevant work experience, education, certifications, location, internal pay equity, etc.
A culture of recognition including new hire welcome announcements, service anniversary awards, referral bonuses, monthly All Employee Assembly, appreciation awards
Generous Paid Time Off, including holidays, vacation days, personal days and sick days
Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), disability & life insurance, pet insurance, and retirement savings
Guided by our mission, we provide full diabetes supply coverage through our medical benefits program
A company focus on offering mental health programs and work/life balance with most of our employees working remote
Joining our dedicated team affords the gratification of knowing beyond a doubt that you will impact the lives and well-being of millions

About The Organization

The American Diabetes Association ® (ADA) is the nation’s leading voluntary health organization fighting to end diabetes and helping people living with diabetes thrive. Since 1940, we have driven discovery and research to prevent, manage, treat, and ultimately cure diabetes. We advocate for policy changes and improved access to quality care for all people living with diabetes and/or obesity. Through the Obesity Association, a division of the ADA, we are also working to reduce the prevalence of obesity—a leading risk factor for type 2 diabetes.

jobs.title: Content Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Title:
Project Manager II – Global Material Review & Content Operations
Location:
Mettawa, IL (Hybrid: 1–2 days/week preferred or as needed; Fully Remote eligible)
Work Schedule:
Based on US Central Time (CST), with flexibility for early morning or late evening meetings across global time zones (e.g., Central/Eastern Europe).

Position Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Project Manager to manage end-to-end promotional and global material review processes within our International Customer Excellence organization. This role serves as the key operational driver and liaison between global brand marketers, external creative agencies, and cross-functional review partners (Medical, Regulatory, Legal, and Compliance). The ideal candidate thrives in a highly collaborative setting, moderating complex stakeholder discussions, enforcing compliance workflows, and driving continuous operational improvements.

Key Requirements

Education:
Bachelor’s degree (mandatory).
Experience:
1–5+ years of hands-on Project Management experience.
Stakeholder Management:
Demonstrated track record of moderating cross-functional meetings, resolving alignment conflicts, and managing diverse international stakeholders.
Organizational Mastery:
Exceptional capability in handling high-volume asset lifecycles, tracking detailed action logs, and multitasking in a fast-paced corporate environment.
Global Flexibility:
Comfort and adaptability working across multiple spontaneous global time zones when collaborating with international teams.
Experience in the Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, or Biotech industry.
Familiarity with Medical/Legal/Regulatory (MLR/MRL) review environments or content operations.
Prior hands-on exposure to review and DAM tools like Veeva Vault PromoMats or Zinc.
Project management or process improvement certifications (e.g., PMP, CAPM, Six Sigma).

Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End MLR Review & Process Management

Own and drive the end-to-end review lifecycle for all assigned brand products, marketing initiatives, and content types (print, digital, interactive, imagery, and production files).
Ensure all global promotional assets strictly adhere to review workflows, corporate quality policies, and compliance standards.
Monitor project milestones against the Global Materials Review Grid (GRID) to prevent approval delays and ensure adherence to launch timelines.
Review final post-approval asset versions, confirm all reviewer changes/comments are incorporated, and secure formal final approvals within the system.

2. Stakeholder Collaboration & Meeting Facilitation

Organize, schedule, and moderate key review touchpoints (concept meetings, collaboration sessions, elevation meetings, and strategy reviews) involving Marketing, Medical, Regulatory, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders.
Serve as an objective mediator during complex collaboration sessions, drive consensus and clear next steps when cross-functional stakeholders present differing viewpoints.
Work directly with third-party creative agencies, vendors, and brand teams during early asset development to provide process guidance on routing materials.
Document, consolidate, and disseminate all decisions, review feedback, action items, and next steps across project teams.

3. Content Operations & Digital Asset Governance

Act as a process subject matter expert for the review system and Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform (e.g., Veeva Vault PromoMats).
Facilitate content reuse across global brands, markets, and marketing channels to reduce redundant creation costs and optimize time-to-market.
Train and onboard internal cross-functional partners and external agency vendors on review tools, submission standards, and operational workflows.

4. Global Affiliate & Regional Coordination

Serve as the central point of contact for international affiliate offices, providing project details, localized assets, and review support for global events, congresses, and market-specific rollouts.
Ensure local affiliate reviews remain aligned with global brand governance and regional compliance mandates.

5. Continuous Improvement & Audit Support

Drive and support internal MLR audit processes, ensuring thorough compliance documentation.
Track and report against MLR process Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to identify bottlenecks and process risks.
Recommend workflow enhancements, process automation opportunities, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) across the Center of Excellence (CoE).
Identify escalation triggers and execute timely escalation paths to leadership when process blockers arise.

jobs.title: Project Manager (User Studies)
jobs.description:
Position:
Project Manager (
User Studies)
Location:
Remote
Job Type:
6+ Months Contract (Possible extension)

Working Hours
: PST
Pay Rate:
$50-60/hr on W2

Position Overview
The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) brings together data, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and computational science capabilities to support scientists across Roche's Research and Early Development organisations at (gRED) and Pharma (pRED). Target Nexus enables user evaluation, feedback, and collaboration across Science & Engineering and the broader organisation. We are seeking a highly motivated, independent, and creative Project Manager to provide hands-on operational support for recurring Target Nexus user studies. The role will work closely with the Science and Engineering User Validation Lead, Science & Engineering, Frontend, Platform, and study participants to ensure studies are well planned, smoothly executed, and translated into actionable product improvements. The Project Manager will also provide burst capacity for business-management-related tasks across the organisation as priorities arise.

Key Responsibilities

● Study Planning: Define timelines, participants, objectives, milestones, and logistics with the Science and Engineering User Validation Lead.
● Report Preparation: Coordinate with Science & Engineering to identify and generate Target Nexus reports for evaluation.
● Feedback Collection: Create Google Forms/Sheets or coordinate in-product feedback with the Frontend team.
● Participant Coordination: Send invitations, schedule sessions, and manage participant communications.
● Session Facilitation: Host sessions, keep discussions on track, and ensure participant engagement.
● Feedback Synthesis: Summarize findings, identify themes, and translate feedback into actionable items for Platform and Science & Engineering.
● Action Tracking: Maintain a feedback backlog and monitor progress through implementation.
Business Management Burst Support: Provide flexible, time-bound support for planning, coordination, reporting, stakeholder follow-up, and operational tracking.

Qualifications & Requirements Education & Experience

● Education:
Bachelors degree or higher; project management coursework or certification preferred, such as PMP, Six Sigma, Lean, Design Thinking, or Agile.
● Industry Experience:
3–5 years of project management, operations, user research operations, product operations, healthcare, life sciences, or a related field.

Skills:

●Experience planning and executing recurring studies, workshops, pilots, evaluations, or structured engagement activities.
● Strong coordination skills across timelines, participant logistics, communications, documentation, and action tracking.
● Comfortability with project and program management tools (e.g. JIRA, Monday.com, Tableau, etc...).
● Experience with feedback collection and reporting workflows using Google Forms, Google Sheets, or comparable tools.
● Strong facilitation, synthesis, and communication skills, with the ability to turn qualitative feedback into themes, insights, and actionable recommendations.
● Comfort working cross-functionally with Science & Engineering, Platform, Frontend, and business stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
● Highly organised, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to respond flexibly to changing priorities.
● A strategic thinker with a strong emphasis on execution, follow-through, and measurable outcomes.
● Comfortable working independently across Central European and US West Coast time zones.
● Available to start immediately and commit to the full assignment through EOY 2026, and extension if necessary.

Soft Skills

● Problem Solving: Proven ability to work independently on complex data problems and navigate fluid, dynamic research environments.
● Collaboration: Strong commitment to working as part of a team and the ability to articulate computational challenges to scientific and engineering peers.

What Success Looks Like

● Target Nexus studies run on a clear, repeatable cadence with prepared participants, reports, and feedback mechanisms.
● Sessions produce focused feedback that is synthesised into clear themes and prioritised actions.
● Feedback actions are visible, owned, and tracked through implementation.
● Business-management support is provided responsively during peak demand without compromising study operations.

This role combines structured project management with hands-on product and user-study operations, helping Target Nexus evolve through a disciplined, participant-centred feedback loop.

jobs.title: Project Manager (52005)
jobs.description:
WHY JOIN AGU

Our employees are our most valuable assets! You will feel welcomed and supported from the moment you join our team, and you will take part in strengthening and evolving our workplace culture.

We offer work-life balance and innovative benefits.

Work-life balance: remote-first organization, flexible work hours, unlimited PTO, Flexible Fridays, paid holidays, military leave, parental leave.
Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, life Insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, wellness, tuition reimbursement, 403(b) retirement plan, FSA, HSA, theft protection, personal and professional development, and much more.

Who We Are

The American Geophysical Union (AGU) supports a global community of more than half a million professionals and advocates in the Earth and space sciences.

Through broad and inclusive partnerships, AGU aims to advance discovery and solution science that accelerates knowledge and creates solutions that are ethical, unbiased, and respectful of communities and their values. Our programs include serving as a scholarly publisher, convening virtual and in-person events, and providing career support. We live our values in everything we do, such as our net-zero energy renovated building in Washington, D.C., and our Ethics and Equity Center, which fosters a diverse and inclusive geoscience community to ensure responsible conduct.

This is an exciting time to work at AGU. Every day we approach our work with a sense of purpose, and we look for others who share that passion and desire for a career with impact.

Who You Are

As the Project Manager you will support AGU’s mission to advance Earth and space sciences for the benefit of humanity by planning and delivering projects that meet established scope, schedule, budget, quality, and performance expectations.

You are responsible for coordinating the execution, implementation, and completion of assigned projects. This includes developing project plans, establishing timelines and budgets, identifying resource needs, tracking progress, managing risks and issues, and coordinating the work of cross-functional team members, vendors, and consultants. The Project Manager ensures that project activities remain aligned with organizational priorities and that changes to scope, schedule, or budget are appropriately evaluated, documented, and communicated.

Working collaboratively with project sponsors, customers, and other stakeholders, the Project Manager helps define project objectives, requirements, deliverables, roles, and measures of success. The position facilitates meetings, maintains project documentation, prepares status reports, supports informed decision-making, and escalates significant risks or barriers when necessary.

You will receive general direction and applies established project management practices, policies, and procedures to assigned work. Success in this role requires strong organizational, analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills; sound judgment; attention to detail; and the ability to build productive working relationships, manage competing priorities, and guide teams toward successful project outcomes.

What You Will Do

Manage assigned projects from initiation through completion, applying established PMO processes, tools, and project management practices.

Collaborate with project sponsors, customers, and cross-functional teams to define project scope, objectives, success criteria, requirements, and deliverables.
Identify project stakeholders and develops appropriate communication and engagement approaches to keep them informed and involved throughout the project lifecycle.
Work with sponsors, team members, contractors, and consultants to develop project deliverables, resource requirements, work plans, budgets, schedules, and measures of success.
Develop and maintains project plans, schedules, budgets, communication plans, risk registers, decision logs, status reports, and other required project documentation.
Organize and coordinates project activities, meetings, dependencies, and deliverables to support timely and effective execution.
Monitor project budgets, forecasts expenses, reviews financial performance, and communicates potential budget variances to the project sponsor and appropriate leadership.
Identify project resource needs and works with functional managers and project sponsors to secure the staff, contractors, consultants, and other resources required for successful delivery.
Coordinate the work of cross-functional project teams, contractors, and consultants, ensuring that roles, responsibilities, expectations, and deadlines are clearly understood.
Establish an appropriate schedule and format for project status reporting and provides clear, accurate, and timely updates on progress, accomplishments, risks, issues, decisions, budgets, and upcoming activities.
Monitor project progress against established scope, schedule, budget, quality, and performance requirements and takes corrective action when necessary.
Identify, documents, tracks, and supports the resolution of project risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and barriers, escalating significant concerns when appropriate.
Manage proposed changes to project scope, schedule, budget, resources, or deliverables through established change-control processes.
Develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans to reduce the potential impact of project risks and unexpected challenges.
Assign and coordinates project tasks, follows up on commitments, and promotes accountability among project team members while recognizing that functional managers retain responsibility for employee supervision and performance management.
Facilitate productive project meetings and discussions, helping teams resolve conflicts, make decisions, and maintain progress toward agreed-upon outcomes.
Build collaborative working relationships with project sponsors, team members, customers, vendors, consultants, and other stakeholders who are essential to project success.
Support effective communication and knowledge sharing across teams, departments, and project stakeholders.
Ensure that project deliverables are reviewed, accepted, documented, and transitioned to the appropriate operational owner.
Conduct project closeout activities, including lessons-learned sessions and post-project evaluations, and documents recommendations to improve future project delivery.
Identify and recommends practical improvements to project processes, tools, and approaches in support of PMO and organizational goals.
Perform other duties as required or assigned which are reasonably within the scope of the duties in this job classification.

What You Will Bring

Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred, with 3+ years of experience working in related field or related environment, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
PMP, or industry equivalent preferred.
Thorough understanding of project/program management techniques and methods.
Experience in association management is preferred.
General understanding of project portfolio management concepts.
Knowledge of MS Office; working knowledge of program/project management software (Basecamp, MS Project, Monday.com etc.) is a strong advantage.
Professional interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills.
Leadership, time management, facilitation, emotional intelligence, and organizational skills.
Strong customer service skills.
problem-solving ability
Flexible during times of change; ability to react to project adjustments and alterations promptly and efficiently.
Ability to effectively prioritize and execute projects in a high-pressure environment is crucial.
Ability to read communication styles of team members and contractors who come from a broad spectrum of disciplines.
Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources.
Ability to bring projects to successful completion through political sensitivity.
Confidence and motivation to operate with independence and to take part in senior leadership efforts as needed.
Demonstrated knowledge of key programmatic, operational, financial, and management issues and priorities.
Capable of exercising discretion on both internal and external confidential matters.
Ability to travel

Agu Essential Values

Accountability: Own it.
Excellence: Give your all.
Member & Customer Service: Members & Customers first.
Teamwork: Together everyone achieves more.
Respect-Earn it and give it.
Integrity- Do the right thing.

HIRING SPECIFICS

We understand that it is unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria listed in a job posting. However, we encourage you to apply if you meet many of the requirements because we know that skills evolve. If you are willing to learn and evolve alongside us, join our team!
Full Time, Exempt position. This remote role is open to candidates living in many U.S. states (excluding WA, OR, and CA at this time).
The salary range for this position is Min. $82,136, Mid. $109,515, Max $136,894. We typically prefer to hire around the min-mid of our range.
Work Authorization: We will not sponsor applicants for work visas in the US.
We care deeply about fairness so you can be ensured that your application will never be judged based on religious belief, age, color, race, creed, marital status, gender, sexual orientation, political affiliation, ethnic origin, or disability.
AGU will make reasonable accommodations in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990.
We are committed to providing inclusive interview experience. If you require reasonable accommodation for any part of the interview process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.
Veterans and people with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Program Manager - HR Transformation (Fixed-Term Contract, Remote)
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Program Manager who thrives on bringing structure, momentum and clarity to complex transformation? This is an opportunity to play a central role in an enterprise program, helping to coordinate and deliver the people activity initiatives that will support a major technology-enabled transformation across the organisation.

Working closely with the HR Program Lead, HR Talent Lead, HR Leadership Team, workstream delivery teams and HRIT, you will ensure activities are well planned, coordinated, tracked and delivered against clear objectives and timelines. You will be the connective tissue across multiple delivery teams, bringing disciplined execution, strong stakeholder management and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast-moving global environment.

This is an 18-month fixed-term contract and can be a fully remote role, giving you the flexibility to work from anywhere in the UK, with optional office access if desired. As an alternative location, we will also consider candidates based in the US Eastern Time Zone.

The Role

• Partner with workstream delivery teams and project managers to turn transformation objectives into practical delivery plans, milestones and execution roadmaps.
• Build and maintain integrated program plans, milestone trackers, RAID logs, risk registers and status dashboards to provide clear visibility of progress.
• Drive day-to-day program execution, ensuring activities remain aligned to agreed objectives, timelines and outcomes.
• Identify and manage dependencies, constraints, risks and critical path activities, escalating issues with clear recommendations and mitigation options.
• Coordinate across delivery teams to ensure key deliverables are completed on schedule and to agreed quality standards.
• Provide structured updates to program leadership and stakeholders on progress, risks, issues, dependencies and decisions.
• Establish and manage governance cadences, including steering committee reviews, workstream check-ins and escalation protocols.
• Build strong working relationships with HRLT, HRIT, Internal Comms and Change Management, Legal, Finance, AI TMO and functional leaders.
• Ensure HRIT and change management deliverables are integrated into program planning, readiness, training and communications activity.
• Promote best practice program management standards and capture lessons learned to improve future transformation initiatives.
• Ensure the program is aligned to and tracking against the financial goals and targets (investment, savings)

What you’ll bring

• Significant project or program management experience delivering complex global transformation in a large enterprise environment.
• Experience in HR transformation, operating model transformation, technology-enabled change or large-scale business change programs.
• A track record of managing multiple cross-functional projects or workstreams simultaneously, including dependencies, risks and stakeholder expectations.
• Experience supporting executive governance forums and preparing clear, decision-focused leadership reporting materials.
• Strong stakeholder management, facilitation and meeting management skills, with the confidence to drive alignment and decisions in ambiguous environments.
• Structured and disciplined delivery skills, with the ability to translate strategic objectives into practical plans and measurable outcomes.
• Working knowledge of both waterfall and agile or hybrid delivery methodologies.
• An analytical mindset, with confidence using data, metrics and technology to inform decisions and status reporting.
• Practical experience using generative AI tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT or equivalent, to improve productivity, problem-solving and business outcomes.
• A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or MSP is desirable.

What we offer

Enjoy a benefits package designed to help you thrive, both professionally and personally. You'll receive 25 days of annual leave plus an extra WTW day to relax and recharge. Our comprehensive health and wellbeing offering includes private healthcare, life insurance, group income protection, and regular health assessments, all giving you peace of mind. Secure your future with our defined contribution pension scheme, featuring matched contributions up to 10% from the company.

We support your growth and balance with hybrid working options, access to an employee assistance programme, and a fully paid volunteer day to make a difference in your community. On top of these, you can opt into a variety of additional perks including an electric vehicle car scheme, share scheme, cycle-to-work programme, dental and optical cover, critical illness protection, and much more. Start making the most of your career and wellbeing with a range of benefits tailored for you.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidatehelpdesk@wtwco.com

jobs.title: Project Manager in Collections & Asset Recovery / Russian Speaker
jobs.description:
We're looking for an experienced Project Manager in Collections & Asset Recovery to improve how we manage delinquent customers, debt collection, fraud prevention and equipment repossession.

The main goal of this role is to reduce losses from delinquency, fraud and theft while increasing cash and equipment recovery rates.

You will own and test initiatives across the full recovery lifecycle — from customer risk scoring and soft collections to hard collections and equipment repossession.

What You'll Do

Lead projects aimed at improving collections and equipment recovery performance
Develop, test and optimize strategies to reduce delinquency, fraud, theft and asset loss
Improve customer risk scoring using customers' data, payment history, and operational data
Optimize the full recovery process: early-stage collections, payment plans, hard collections, repossession and external escalation
Analyze portfolio performance and identify patterns behind default, fraud and equipment loss
Design and test new workflows, policies, communication strategies and recovery approaches
Define and improve KPIs across collections, fraud and repossession
Use AI coding tools such as Codex and Claude Code for data analysis, prototyping, automation and internal tool development
Work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Analytics, and Marketing teams to implement changes
Track results and report directly to senior management and founders

Requirements

5+ years of experience in project or product management within operationally complex businesses, with responsibility for improving processes, systems, and business performance
Strong analytical and project management skills
Strong understanding of operational processes and data-driven decision-making
Experience with collections, delinquent customers, fraud prevention or asset recovery is an advantage
Hands-on experience with AI coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code or similar is required
Comfortable working with CRM/ERP systems, workflows and operational data
Ability to independently identify problems, test solutions and drive implementation
Fluent English (C1+)
Russian language proficiency is a plus
Availability during US Eastern Time business hours

Benefits

Join New York's largest e-bike rental company, a fast-growing startup that has raised $20M+ in funding
Work directly with founders and senior leadership
High ownership over projects with direct impact on profitability and loss reduction
Fully remote, full-time role
Base salary from $5,000/month + performance bonus

MAP International is seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our IT team and lead delivery of the projects driving our technology transformation. The ideal candidate brings a track record of shipping technology projects on time in a resource-conscious environment, communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical partners, and is enthusiastic about using AI tools to work faster and better. Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Project Planning and Execution

Company description

VAULTED AG is a Swiss deep-tech start-up born from research at ETH Zurich and the Empa innovation ecosystem. We combine world-class engineering, computational design, digital fabrication and advanced manufacturing to rethink how buildings are designed and delivered.
Our core technology, the Rippmann Floor System® (RFS)
, reduces structural mass by up to 70%, steel use by up to 90%, and embodied carbon by up to 75% compared with conventional concrete slabs.
As we scale from pioneering projects to repeatable international delivery and commercial growth across Switzerland, Belgium, the UK and the US
, we are looking for an exceptional Project Manager
to take ownership of VAULTED projects once they move from commercial opportunity into execution.

Role description

Your job is simple to describe, but challenging to do exceptionally well: make sure we deliver what we promised.

You will be the central point of contact connecting our customers with VAULTED's engineering, design, operations and commercial teams as well as external suppliers and project partners. You will create structure where there is ambiguity, anticipate problems before they become critical, keep decisions and people moving, and ensure customers feel that their project is in safe hands.
This role requires someone who is highly structured and driven, but equally strong with people
: someone who builds trusted relationships, listens and understands different perspectives, while also being comfortable setting boundaries, challenging constructively and holding people to commitments.

At VAULTED, you'll join a highly international and interdisciplinary team with a strong culture of collaboration, trust and individual ownership. You'll have significant responsibility from day one and help shape not only individual projects, but also how VAULTED delivers projects as we scale.

What you’ll do

Own project delivery:
Lead VAULTED projects from commercial handover through successful delivery, keeping scope, milestones, responsibilities, timelines and quality on track.
Lead the customer relationship:
Be the main point of contact for customers and key project stakeholders. Build trust, manage expectations proactively and handle difficult conversations with clarity and confidence.
Create clarity and momentum:
Turn complex situations into clear decisions, actions, owners and deadlines. Identify risks and bottlenecks early, remove blockers and escalate where needed.
Coordinate teams and partners:

Senior Project Manager - Delivery Operations & Strategy (SN Digital)

About US

The company

Springer Nature opens the doors to discovery for researchers, educators, clinicians, and other professionals. Every day, around the globe, our imprints, books, journals, platforms, and technology solutions reach millions of people. For over 175 years our brands and imprints have been a trusted source of knowledge to these communities and today, more than ever, we see it as our responsibility to ensure that fundamental knowledge can be found, verified, understood, and used by our communities – enabling them to improve outcomes, make progress, and benefit the generations that follow.

About SN Digital

Over the past few years, Springer Nature has grown rapidly and as a result, the Discipline and Domain structure was introduced in SN Digital, in a matrix fashion. The aim of the Domain structure is to address scalability issues by uniting teams with a similar goal or focus to work together, whilst Disciplines work as Communities of Practise that allow our colleagues to collaborate on developing their craft.

Domains operate as a “network of teams” with a high degree of empowerment, strong communication, and rapid information flow. Teams within the Domain still have the same autonomy and responsibilities but are part of a wider ‘network of teams with a shared responsibility to collaborate and pull in the same direction. The team is not only working towards the betterment of the team’s products or services, but in doing so they are also working towards achieving the goals of the Domain.

Purpose of the Role

We are seeking a Senior Project Manager to manager programmes of work across Delivery Operations and Strategy. This role will focus on initiatives that are aligned with our technology strategy, drive operational excellence, and provide frameworks for teams to deliver effectively and consistently. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in working on complex programmes of work.

You will be responsible for understanding complex projects and working with a cross-functional team to understand business needs aligned to technology solutions. Often this will be working across different domains within SN Digital and must be able to collaborate and align teams towards targeted outcomes.

This role also acts as a bridge between delivery teams and senior leadership. They will ensure that the priorities, resources and expertise of the teams are in line with the organisational goals to deliver successfully across our portfolio.

The job can be based in any of our main Digital locations (London, Lisbon, Berlin, Dordrecht, Pune), and you will work remotely at times with colleagues in many of our global offices including Lisbon, London (UK), Pune (India), Dordrecht (The Netherlands) and Berlin (Germany). Some travel will be required as appropriate.

About You

You’re an experienced project manager who has supported complex, multi-portfolio programmes from start to finish. With over seven years working at programme or portfolio level you know how to work with high-performing, psychologically safe teams that consistently deliver.

You will work collaboratively with solutions architecture, business analysis and senior leadership to ensure roadmaps, budgets and resources are aligned with strategic priorities. You combine strategic vision with operational discipline and are comfortable working at whatever level programmes require, whether it’s with senior executives or delivery teams.

You can communicate effectively, and your approach is collaborative, focuses on unblocking teams and aligning people towards shared goals. You have in-depth knowledge and experience of agile, Lean and hybrid delivery methodologies and can use delivery tooling and dashboards to enhance transparency. Above all, you have a drive to create a culture of continuous improvement to foster teams that learn fast, adapt quickly and deliver outcomes that make a measurable impact.

Project Delivery Excellence

Successfully initiate, plan, govern, and deliver complex cross-domain programmes of work

Demand & Strategic Planning

Continuous Improvement & Change

Senior Project Manager - Delivery Operations & Strategy (SN Digital)

About US

The company

Springer Nature opens the doors to discovery for researchers, educators, clinicians, and other professionals. Every day, around the globe, our imprints, books, journals, platforms, and technology solutions reach millions of people. For over 175 years our brands and imprints have been a trusted source of knowledge to these communities and today, more than ever, we see it as our responsibility to ensure that fundamental knowledge can be found, verified, understood, and used by our communities – enabling them to improve outcomes, make progress, and benefit the generations that follow.

About SN Digital

Over the past few years, Springer Nature has grown rapidly and as a result, the Discipline and Domain structure was introduced in SN Digital, in a matrix fashion. The aim of the Domain structure is to address scalability issues by uniting teams with a similar goal or focus to work together, whilst Disciplines work as Communities of Practise that allow our colleagues to collaborate on developing their craft.

Domains operate as a “network of teams” with a high degree of empowerment, strong communication, and rapid information flow. Teams within the Domain still have the same autonomy and responsibilities but are part of a wider ‘network of teams with a shared responsibility to collaborate and pull in the same direction. The team is not only working towards the betterment of the team’s products or services, but in doing so they are also working towards achieving the goals of the Domain.

Purpose of the Role

We are seeking a Senior Project Manager to manager programmes of work across Delivery Operations and Strategy. This role will focus on initiatives that are aligned with our technology strategy, drive operational excellence, and provide frameworks for teams to deliver effectively and consistently. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in working on complex programmes of work.

You will be responsible for understanding complex projects and working with a cross-functional team to understand business needs aligned to technology solutions. Often this will be working across different domains within SN Digital and must be able to collaborate and align teams towards targeted outcomes.

This role also acts as a bridge between delivery teams and senior leadership. They will ensure that the priorities, resources and expertise of the teams are in line with the organisational goals to deliver successfully across our portfolio.

The job can be based in any of our main Digital locations (London, Lisbon, Berlin, Dordrecht, Pune), and you will work remotely at times with colleagues in many of our global offices including Lisbon, London (UK), Pune (India), Dordrecht (The Netherlands) and Berlin (Germany). Some travel will be required as appropriate.

About You

You’re an experienced project manager who has supported complex, multi-portfolio programmes from start to finish. With over seven years working at programme or portfolio level you know how to work with high-performing, psychologically safe teams that consistently deliver.

You will work collaboratively with solutions architecture, business analysis and senior leadership to ensure roadmaps, budgets and resources are aligned with strategic priorities. Above all, you have a drive to create a culture of continuous improvement to foster teams that learn fast, adapt quickly and deliver outcomes that make a measurable impact.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Saras Analytics

Saras Analytics is an AI and data analytics firm built for ecommerce and omnichannel brands. We help fast-growing SMBs and mid-market brands turn disconnected, messy data into decisions — covering ingestion, transformation, and consumption, backed by our own products (Daton and IQ) as the data infrastructure underneath every engagement. Our consulting team is built around forward deployed analysts, data scientists, and subject matter experts who sit close to the client and turn data into strategic guidance CXOs act on.
Why Now

Saras is profitable and bootstrapped. We run flat: talent and good ideas move fast here regardless of tenure or title. Right now our Consulting department is scaling fast — more clients, more concurrent engagements, more moving pieces — and leadership needs to see the department's efficiency and health without pulling delivery teams off client work to report on it. A Program Manager joining now builds that operating system from scratch, not inherits it.
The Role

You'll be the single person accountable for internal process compliance across the Consulting department, reporting to the Head of Consulting. This is a one-of-a-kind, individual contributor seat: you carry no client accounts and no direct reports — your product is the department's operating discipline itself. You'll define and own the efficiency and health metrics leadership has asked to see — bugs caught, requirements and BRDs drafted, new features developed, sev1 issues handled — and run the written review rhythm that keeps every internal initiative moving to an outcome. This is not a client-facing role.
The Bar

Compliance that holds without you in the room is the top priority for this role. A metric nobody trusts, or a process people quietly route around, isn't done — the bar is a department whose health leadership can read at any time, from numbers the delivery teams themselves stand behind.
What You'll Own

Understand the machine before you change it.
Map the department's current delivery tools and workflows end to end — how work enters, moves, and ships — so every process you later define fits how delivery actually runs, not how a template says it should.
Define the metrics and processes that answer leadership's visibility asks.
Turn requests like "how healthy is the department?" into a concrete, instrumented metric set — bugs, BRDs drafted, features developed, sev1s handled, and the ones you propose — each with a definition the teams agree to, a source of truth, and a cadence. Then build the lightweight processes that keep those numbers accurate without adding reporting burden.
Run initiative reviews the Amazon way.
Every review starts with the room silently reading a written summary, followed by comments and clarifying questions — no slide theatre, no status meetings that could have been a document. You write sharply, you hold the quality bar on what others write, and you keep the ritual honest: documents exist to drive decisions, not to be graded.
Drive initiatives to outcomes and closure.
An initiative that's "ongoing" for two quarters is failing. Track every internal initiative to a decision, a shipped result, or an explicit kill — and make the closure visible.
Enforce without becoming the person people route around.
Process compliance holds because the teams see the value, not because you're policing them. When a rule creates more friction than signal, fix the rule.

What Winning Looks Like

First 90 days:
you've mapped the delivery workflow end to end, agreed the first version of the metric set with the Head of Consulting, and run your first initiative reviews — written summary, silent read, comments — with the department showing up prepared.
Steady state:
leadership reads the department's efficiency and health from your standing review, not by asking around; every metric has a definition the teams stand behind; and initiatives visibly close — decided, shipped, or killed — instead of lingering.
Who Thrives Here

Any of these backgrounds can get you in the room. Across all of them: 7–10 years of experience, and at least once you've defined — not inherited — an executive-facing metrics system that leadership actually ran on.
You've run programs or operating mechanisms at Amazon or an Amazon-influenced organization — written narratives, business reviews, metrics-driven cadences — and you left with the mechanism, not the pathology.
You've worked in delivery excellence or delivery governance at a premier consulting firm or large services firm — process compliance, KPI systems, governance forums — and you want your recommendations implemented, not filed in a deck.
You've been a Business Operations / Strategy & Operations individual contributor at a strong Indian tech startup, owning a department's operating cadence, metrics, and OKR system.
You're a Technical Program Manager from a product or engineering organization who lives on sev metrics, bug counts, and release governance — and doesn't need a team reporting to you to have impact.
You have enough delivery-domain fluency to argue with a senior delivery lead about what counts as a sev1 or an adequate BRD — these metrics are not abstractions to you.

It's an even stronger fit if you also bring:

You write to drive decisions — narratives, business cases, review documents — and you're comfortable proving it: we interview in the same format the role runs, starting from a written sample.
You've enforced a standard on people senior to you, and can tell the story of where it held and where it failed — you know how to hold a bar without becoming the person people route around.
You moved from client-facing consulting (analytics or tech) into an internal operating seat — and stayed, because the leverage is real.
You can show 2–3 initiatives you personally drove to closure with a before/after metric delta — not tracked, driven.

Hands-on fluency with delivery tooling (ClickUp, Jira, or similar) and AI tools like Claude to automate the reporting so the humans only do the judgment.

jobs.description:
Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.
Who we are supporting

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.
The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:
Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.
The program

Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)

The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO’s principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.
To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce.
Role ID –
C005252

Role Duties and Responsibilities

Responsible for the management of NSIP projects and, in particular, the implementation of major procurement projects in the area of Cyber Security.
Identify, plan, request and manage the deployment of resources to meet project milestones and initiate corrective actions when necessary.
Responsible for the definition, execution and satisfactory completion of his/her projects, including preparation and submission of project proposals, contribution to source selections according to the defined procurement strategy.
Review and agree project approach with his/her Projects Portfolio Manager following Agency processes.
Monitor and control project progress and risk to ensure resources are consumed in accordance with the approved budget and within the approved timelines.
Provide regular status reports on the progress of projects to leadership, senior executives, and NATO committees.
Take responsibility for understanding customer requirements, collecting data, delivering analysis and problem resolution.
Propose appropriate actions to provide an increased level of confidence and reduce risks such that the project will meet its objectives in terms of deliverables (scope and quality), schedule, and costs.
Provide effective and positive leadership to the project team.
Take appropriate action when project performance deviates from agreed tolerances through risk management.
Contribute to other project related activities to support the continuous improvement of Project Management within the NCI Agency.

Recent experience as a Project Manager for a large organization- focused on the delivery of C4ISR capabilities within the defence sector;
At least 2 years direct experience with NATO or a National Ministry of Defense in the delivery of military, CIS, or IT capabilities;

Significant and recent experience in the development of
Statements of Work used as the basis for competitive bidding from

Location: Gloucester, Massachusetts (On-Site)

Project Delivery & Execution

• Review and intake physical security project assessments provided by business stakeholders.

Vendor & Financial Management

• Track materials allocation, installation sequencing, and vendor deliverables for security design and implementation.
• Support project budget planning, tracking, forecasting, and variance reporting.

Standards, Governance & Continuous Improvement

Functional Knowledge

Skills

• Budget tracking, schedule management, and risk mitigation.
• Analytical mindset with attention to detail and sustainability.
• High proficiency in Microsoft Office and security project documentation tools.

Summary

Location

Birmingham, London, Manchester, Reading

Job Family

Ref #

74821

We currently have an opportunity to join the Strategy, Data and Transformation team within Fixed Wholesale and Customer Delivery as a Senior Project Manager, where you will play a central role in delivering high impact transformation initiatives. You will lead projects that drive productivity, optimise processes and enable future ways of working across the business.

In this role, you will take ownership of end to end project delivery, bringing structure, governance and clarity across complex programmes. You will work cross functionally to align stakeholders, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure successful delivery against strategic objectives while maintaining a strong focus on measurable business outcomes.

Who we are

At Virgin Media O₂, we connect people to the moments that matter most. Virgin Media leads the UK for broadband reliability, speed and overall performance, while O₂ keeps people connected on the move with award-winning coverage.

We’re also proud to be named one of the Financial Times Top 500 Best Employers for 2026, based on one of the UK’s largest employee satisfaction surveys.

Join us and you’ll be part of a team that stays curious, positive and focused on making life easier for our customers and each other. We’re investing in the future of connectivity, from expanding next-generation 5G to exploring satellite-supported solutions that help reach rural communities and hard-to-connect places. 

You’ll work with people who back good ideas and give you plenty of room to grow. So if you’re looking for a place where you can feel supported, trusted and genuinely valued, you’ll feel right at home here.

Our ways of working

We’re a flexible-first organisation, because we know people do their best work when they have choice and clarity. To support meaningful collaboration, we ask everyone to spend at least eight days a month connecting with each other in person.

That doesn’t just mean time in the office – it could be team meetings, offsites, volunteering days, cross-functional projects, or away days. What matters is making those moments count – so when we come together, it benefits everyone.

**Accessible, inclusive and equitable for all **

We believe a better tomorrow starts with the choices we make today. That means moving the dial on diversity, building equity into everything we do and putting inclusion at the heart of our business.

Virgin Media O₂ is an equal opportunities employer and we work hard to remove bias and barriers. We want every person who joins us – and everyone thinking about joining us – to feel seen, heard and supported.

When you work with us, you’ll have access to our award-winning employee network groups. These communities bring people together, champion allyship and create uplifting spaces where you can learn, share and feel part of something bigger. They play a big role in helping people feel connected from day one.

The must haves

In order to be considered, you must have the following experience

Proven experience delivering complex transformation projects
Strong experience managing end to end project lifecycles
Experience of project governance including RAID, steering groups and financial tracking
Strong stakeholder management skills across multiple levels
Experience managing cross functional teams

The other stuff we are looking for

We'd also love you to bring;

Knowledge of project methodologies such as Agile, PRINCE2 or APM
Understanding of change management and business readiness practices
Strong influencing and communication skills
Excellent planning, organisation and problem solving capability
Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive progress in a fast paced environment

What's in it for you

We know life isn’t just about work, so our benefits are built to support you in the moments that matter. You’ll get Bupa healthcare, wellbeing support, life cover, a pension and generous holiday –plus your birthday off.

And there’s more. Enjoy some extra perks on us, with optional electric vehicle lease and Cycle2Work schemes, dental insurance, neurodiversity assessments, and brilliant discounts on broadband, TV and mobile. You’ll even get access to the Virgin Family platform and the O₂ Priority app, with exclusive rewards, experiences and chances to attend events at The O₂ and beyond.

Next steps

If this feels like a place where you can belong, we’d love to see what you can do. Once you apply, the next steps might include a call with a recruiter, a video interview, an interview with the hiring manager and a task or assessment.

We’ll also ask about any adjustments you might need, and we’ll do our best to make them happen.

We review applications and interview throughout the advert window, so it’s worth applying sooner rather than later. If you’re offered the role, the offer will be subject to background checks, including a criminal record check and, for some roles, a financial background check.

Description

1898 & Co., a division of Burns & McDonnell, is seeking an experienced Grid Systems Project Manager to provide utility grid operations modernization consulting services for our electric utility clients. The selected candidate will join the Enterprise System & Integration team, which is focused on providing Enterprise Solution Services, delivering high value to our clients through a variety of leading technologies. The grid operations project manager shall possess strong electric utility business and technology acumen. The grid operations project manager will provide professional consulting services focused on solutions such as Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA), Energy Management Systems (EMS), Outage Management Systems (OMS), Distribution Management Systems (DMS), Advanced Distribution Management Systems (ADMS), and Distributed Energy Resource Management Systems (DERMS). Candidates must have strong project execution capabilities, strong leadership and collaboration capabilities, and excellent communication skills, be focused on continuous improvement and enterprise innovation, and have strong attention to detail while delivering high-quality work to our clients. You’ll work with people who back good ideas and give you plenty of room to grow. So if you’re looking for a place where you can feel supported, trusted and genuinely valued, you’ll feel right at home here.

We’re a flexible-first organisation, because we know people do their best work when they have choice and clarity. To support meaningful collaboration, we ask everyone to spend at least eight days a month connecting with each other in person.

That doesn’t just mean time in the office – it could be team meetings, offsites, volunteering days, cross-functional projects, or away days. What matters is making those moments count – so when we come together, it benefits everyone.

We believe a better tomorrow starts with the choices we make today. That means moving the dial on diversity, building equity into everything we do and putting inclusion at the heart of our business.

Virgin Media O₂ is an equal opportunities employer and we work hard to remove bias and barriers. We want every person who joins us – and everyone thinking about joining us – to feel seen, heard and supported.

And there’s more. You’ll even get access to the Virgin Family platform and the O₂ Priority app, with exclusive rewards, experiences and chances to attend events at The O₂ and beyond.

**Hybrid in Brookfield, WI preferred**

Will look remote for the right candidate.

ProShip, Inc. is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Project Manager
to join our Integration Team, a customer-facing, revenue-generating department that bills work on a time and materials
basis. Our team implements and integrates the ProShip Software Suite for some of the largest and most recognizable companies in the United States. This role is ideal for a driven professional who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys direct customer interaction, and is excited to contribute to a rapidly growing organization.

As a Project Manager, you will lead the planning, execution, and delivery of customer integration projects, ensuring high-quality results, customer satisfaction, and adherence to budget and time constraints. You will operate as a primary point of contact for our customers, guiding them through implementation activities and maintaining alignment with internal engineering and professional services teams.

Key Responsibilities

Customer-Facing Leadership

Serve as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams throughout the project lifecycle.
Build strong customer relationships by understanding customer goals, communicating expectations clearly, and addressing stakeholder concerns.
Lead regular customer-facing meetings, providing updates, risk assessments, and solution guidance.

Project Planning & Execution

Manage multiple integration projects from initiation through delivery, ensuring projects remain within defined scope, budget, and time and materials billing structure.
Evaluate business requirements and user needs; create detailed project plans that include scope, timelines, dependencies, and milestones.
Facilitate stakeholder sign-off at all required phases.

Scope Management & Change Control

Proactively identify, evaluate, and negotiate scope changes while balancing customer expectations and departmental capacity.
Ensure all time and materials work is accurately tracked, documented, and communicated to customers.

Documentation & Quality Assurance

Develop clear user interface guides, functional specification documents, use cases, release notes, and decision logs.
Coordinate internal and customer QA and UAT activities, ensuring all functionality is validated, issues are documented, and sign-offs are obtained.

Post-Implementation

Conduct post-project reviews and share results internally to drive continuous improvement.
Support ongoing customer engagement and handoff to long-term support teams.

Team Collaboration

Work closely with Professional Services leadership and Software Engineers to deliver solutions aligned with customer needs and ProShip standards.
Foster a collaborative, positive project culture.

Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
4+ years of Project Management experience, ideally in a software integration or development environment.
2+ years of experience as a Business Analyst preferred.
Strong project leadership experience managing internal and external resources.
Experience managing customer relationships in a time and materials billing structure.
Familiarity with Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects across all phases of the project lifecycle.
Excellent verbal and written communication, capable of engaging both technical and non-technical audiences.
Highly organized with strong time management skills and attention to detail.
Proficiency with project management tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
Knowledge of the logistics or shipping industry is a plus.
PMP certification is a plus.

Why Join ProShip?

ProShip offers a collaborative environment focused on professional and personal development. Benefits include:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Life and accident coverage
Short- and long-term disability
Flexible spending & dependent care options
401(k) with company match
Wellness programs
Tuition assistance
Paid vacation, holidays, and sick time
Monthly team lunches, company outings, and casual dress code

Be part of a fast-moving team that values innovation, customer success, and professional growth.

jobs.title: Senior Market & Product Intelligence manager
jobs.description:
Senior Market & Product Intelligence Manager (Tissue Converting)

Providing data-driven insights to support product strategy, business development and competitive positioning across Emerging Markets.

Join Valmet’s Tissue Converting Business Unit as a Senior Market & Product Intelligence Manager and become part of the Product Management team, playing a key role in leading market, product and competitive analysis activities to support business development and product strategy.

This role is focused on delivering clear, data-driven insights, with a strong emphasis on technology and product development within the tissue converting sector.

In this position, your primary focus will be on analyzing market segments, defining product specifications and evaluating competitive positioning. You will contribute to business growth by providing actionable recommendations for future product development, including technical specifications and product characteristics aligned with market needs.

The role operates within an international context, with a particular focus on Emerging Markets (Africa, Middle East and Asia Pacific), ensuring alignment between market requirements, product development and competitive dynamics.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Senior Market & Product Intelligence Manager, your responsibilities include:

Market & Product Analysis

Analyze key market segments to support growth and increase market share
Evaluate customer needs and define product specifications, performance expectations and line configurations
Provide recommendations for new product development based on market insights
Map differences between geographies and identify growth opportunities
Monitor regulations impacting the business (packaging, water usage, energy consumption, etc.)
Focus on regional priorities such as:
Product and performance needs in emerging markets (Africa, Middle East & Asia Pacific) based on Project Tracker report
Price/performance positioning of Chinese & low-cost competitors
Develop technical and detailed SWOT analysis to compare company and competitor portfolios

Competitive Intelligence

Analyze competitors using public sources (web, LinkedIn, industry publications) and internal intelligence (e.g. offers)
Develop clear insights on competitor products, technologies and value propositions
Assess price/performance levels to define competitive positioning in each market segment
Organize and structure information using corporate tools (Valona, Numera, RISI)
Consolidate data into the competitive intelligence hub
Analyze competitor financials where available to evaluate performance and positioning

Data-Driven Approach

Ensure all analyses are based on reliable data and clearly referenced sources
Clearly explain assumptions behind market estimates
Deliver structured insights and actionable recommendations for business development and product strategy

Required Experience And Qualification

We are looking for a senior professional with a strong technical background and solid experience in market and competitive analysis within the tissue converting sector.

To succeed in this role, you will have the following profile:

5 -10 years of relevant experience, ideally in the tissue industry
Strong technical background (product/technology understanding is required)
Proven experience in market analysis, competitive intelligence and product strategy
Ability to translate data into clear insights and concrete recommendations
Experience working with multiple data sources and market intelligence tools
Strong analytical, organizational and communication skills

In addition, we appreciate

Experience in the tissue converting industry or closely related sectors
Familiarity with competitive intelligence tools and data sources
Structured and analytical mindset with attention to detail
Ability to translate market insights into clearly defined product specifications, supporting concrete product development decisions across different regions

What We Offer

Opportunity to play a key role in supporting product strategy and business development in Emerging Markets
Exposure to global markets and cross-functional collaboration within the Product Management team
A dynamic and international working environment within Valmet’s Tissue Converting Business Unit
Opportunities for professional growth and development within a global organization

Travel

Availability to travel up to 30%

Other Information

The onboarding program includes two 2-week induction periods in Italy, separated by a return to the home location
Experience with standard business tools, including Microsoft Office, SharePoint and Power BI (if applicable)

Location

This position is based in Pune, India, with flexible hybrid working practices.

jobs.title: Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

Insitu, a subsidiary of Boeing, has pioneered the design, manufacturing and operation of high-performance Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS) with superior payload capabilities. Insitu’s world-class manufacturing facilities are located in Bingen, WA and deliver the highest quality products on time. We are on a mission to be the world’s most trusted partner; developing and integrating world-class solutions that support customer success in the most challenging environments. Discover a career in Aviation where you are a part of the UAS future while working in a supportive environment focused on Pioneering, Performing, Caring and Unity.

Join our dynamic Security team and help protect our organization from evolving threats. We are seeking a Threat Intelligence Analyst with expertise in investigative analysis, threat intelligence, digital forensic, security monitoring, and risk mitigation. Your work will directly support our Insider Threat Program, cybersecurity program, and broader information security initiatives, helping safeguard critical assets and ensure compliance with security best practices. Help protect classified information systems and sensitive organizational data from internal and external threats.

Key Responsibilities:

Use intelligence aggregation tools to review and assess potential insider threats.
Monitor for concerning behaviors and escalate high-risk incidents for investigation.
Conduct investigative activities including forensic acquisition and analysis of digital assets, interview planning, gathering statements, and resolving allegations.
Recover stolen intellectual property and perform forensic analysis of systems or malware as required.
Produce clear, detailed reports documenting investigative findings, outcomes, and security incidents.
Partner with Security, HR, Legal, and other stakeholders to coordinate investigations and remedial actions
Develop and refine investigation metrics, dashboards, case studies, and trend analyses to support program improvement and decision-making
Plan, implement, upgrade, and monitor computer network/information security measures and controls.
Serve as ISSO/ISSM for multiple classified information systems, ensuring compliance with applicable government and organizational cyber security requirements.
Identify security needs and develop system security plans; coordinate implementation of security architecture and applications.
Oversee security sustainment activities including account management, media protection, audit logging, and secure file processes
Perform risk assessments, penetration testing, system log analysis, and vulnerability evaluations.
Develop and execute risk remediation plans, recommend security technologies.
Conduct user compliance monitoring and address organizational security deficiencies.
Develop, deliver, and update security awareness training and materials.
Assist with maintaining ongoing security infrastructure, update cyber protection measures, and research or develop incident response tools and processes.
Produce intelligence products (alerts, briefs, reports) that translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable guidance for stakeholders.
Perform proactive threat hunting in classified and unclassified environments to identify anomalous behavior and previously undetected threats.

Education & Experience:

Technical bachelor’s degree and 5 or more years related work experience or a master’s degree with 3 or more years or equivalent work experience.
Proven experience in threat intelligence, insider threat analysis, cyber security, and information security investigations.
Strong analytical skills; ability to review and assess intelligence and monitor indicators of compromise.
Experience with intelligence aggregation tools, vulnerability assessment, and risk remediation.
Proficiency in forensic analysis, log analysis, penetration testing, and malware investigation.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of producing clear investigative and security reports.
Knowledge of security architecture, firewalls, and safeguarding procedures.
Familiarity with incident response and recovery steps for security breaches.
Meticulous attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills, ensuring thorough analysis and effective threat response.
Demonstrated ability to exercise discretion, maintain confidentiality, and handle sensitive information appropriately.
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance
Familiarity with scripting or automation (e.g. python, powershell)
Knowledge of RMF and government cybersecurity guidance (e.g., NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, CNSSI 1253), and related authorization frameworks.
Experience or familiarity with common information security tools, such as: EDR, Firewall, SIEM, Email Archiver, SEG, DSP, Forensic Suites, eDiscovery, UBA, MDM, and HW/SW write blockers

Preferred Education and Experience:

Degree in Information Security, Cyber Security, Computer Science, Criminal Justice or related field preferred.
Professional cybersecurity or forensic certification desired (e.g. A+, Security+, CISSP, GCIA, GCFA, GCFE, CFCE, ENCE, or similar)

Relocation:

This position is inellgible for relocation assistance. Visit our Careers - Insitu
page
to learn more about our benefits, 9/80 work schedule and flexible work model.

We let the type of work you do determine the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.

This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration at minimum once per quarter and therefore needs to be within commutable distance from Bingen, WA.
