jobs.title: Senior Applied Threat Intelligence Analyst - Microsoft Security Threat Response
jobs.description:
Overview

Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate.

Microsoft Security Research, is at the front line of defending Microsoft customers and the broader ecosystem against the world's most sophisticated threat actors. Our Applied Threat Intelligence Production team transforms raw signal from Microsoft's scale of telemetry into actionable, customer-facing intelligence that empowers defenders, informs product decisions, and shapes the public narrative on the threat landscape. We partner deeply across Microsoft Threat Intelligence, product engineering, research, marketing, and communications to ship intel that moves markets and protects organizations everywhere.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Applied Threat Intelligence Analyst:

Author and publish high-impact threat intelligence reports (actor profiles, campaign analyses, trend reports, TTP deep-dives, vulnerability profiles) for both customer-facing and internal audiences.
Build and refine the pipelines, tooling, and workflows that allow Microsoft to stream insightful cyber threat intelligence to customers machine speed.
Represent Microsoft Threat Intelligence in customer briefings, industry conferences, and cross-industry working groups.
Translate technical findings into clear, actionable insights for security operations teams and technical stakeholders.
Partner with product, engineering, and research teams to operationalize intelligence into Microsoft security platforms (e.g., Defender XDR, Sentinel, customer briefings).
Contribute to scalable workflows and pipelines that improve how threat intelligence is generated, refined, and delivered to customers.
Support customer engagements (briefings, responses, and discussions) with accurate and timely intelligence insights.
Collaborate within the team to improve analytic tradecraft, knowledge sharing, and intelligence quality.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

Doctorate in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field.
OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 3+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection.
OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 4+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection.
OR equivalent experience.

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Microsoft Cloud Background Check

This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications

Doctorate in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 3+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection.
OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 6+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection.
OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 8+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection.
OR equivalent experience.

5+ years of experience in cyber threat intelligence, threat hunting, incident response, or a closely related security discipline.
Demonstrated experience producing finished threat intelligence reporting for technical audiences.
Attribution experience creating threat groups, assessing connections between established threat groups, and communicating attribution assessments to internal stakeholders and customers in a timely manner.
Working experience with Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender XDR (or directly comparable SIEM/XDR platforms).
Understanding of adversary tradecraft, the cyber kill chain, and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, the Diamond Model, and structured analytic techniques.
Written and verbal communication skills, with a portfolio of public or customer-facing intelligence writing.
Experience analyzing endpoint, cloud, identity, and network telemetry.
Familiarity with scripting or data analysis tools (Python, KQL, SQL, PowerShell).
Understanding of OS internals, network protocols, and common attack techniques.
Exposure to reverse engineering or malware analysis.
Functional understanding of common threat analysis models such as the Diamond Model, Cyber Kill Chain, and MITRE ATT&CK.
Programming or scripting background (Python, PowerShell, C#, C++, etc.).

About Zego

At Zego, we understand that traditional motor insurance holds good drivers back. It's too complicated, too expensive, and it doesn't reflect how well you actually drive. Since 2016, we have been on a mission to change that by offering the lowest priced insurance for good drivers.

From van drivers and gig workers to everyday car drivers, our customers are the driving force behind everything we do. We've sold tens of millions of policies and raised over $200 million in funding and picked up numerous awards, including the Insurance Claims Team Of The Year 2024 as awarded at The Insurance Post's Claims & Fraud Awards. And we're only just getting started.
Purpose of the role

We're looking for a proactive and analytical Claims Data Analyst to help us enhance our Claims and Fraud operations, shaping one of the most vital areas of the insurance industry.
As part of a fast-growing, product-led tech company, you'll play a key role in driving impactful change within our rapidly scaling Claims team. Your insights will power strategic decision-making, improve efficiency, and uncover opportunities for continuous improvement. Expect to work on developing insightful reports and dashboards, collaborating closely with Claims and Fraud teams, and delivering data-backed recommendations to leadership and stakeholders across the business.
If you thrive in a fast-paced, data-centric environment and are eager to make a real difference in the evolution of claims operations, we'd love to hear from you!
What you will be doing

Design & build core data models and reporting to support Claims and Fraud operations
Develop key reports for senior stakeholders, including Zego leadership, investors, and insurance partners
Analyze performance & identify trends, uncovering key drivers to optimise processes
Spot and size opportunities for continuous improvement, tracking the impact of initiatives
Support strategic decision-making for the Claims and Fraud leadership team
Translate data into compelling stories—delivering actionable insights to senior management
Collaborate cross-functionally, supporting Claims, Fraud, Pricing, and external reporting needs

What you will need to be successful

Got a degree? Great! If not, equivalent experience works too (bonus points if it's in a STEM subject)
SQL Skills - You know your way around data extraction and manipulation like a pro
Power BI Expertise - You've built data models, reports, and dashboards before and can turn raw numbers into something meaningful
Data Storytelling - You can take complex insights and turn them into clear, engaging stories that senior stakeholders (think senior managers, investors, Zego's board, and insurance partners) actually understand
Insurance Know-How (Nice to have!) - If you understand the motor insurance market and what drives commercial performance, that's a big plus
Claims & Financial Acumen (Nice to have!) - Familiarity with claims processes, reserving, and settlements? Even better
Actuarial & Reserving Knowledge (Nice to have!) - If you can be the go-to person between Claims, Fraud, and Actuarial teams, we'd love to have you on board!

What's it like to work at Zego?

Joining Zego is a career-defining move. People go further here, reaching their full potential to achieve extraordinary things. 
We're spread throughout the UK and Europe, and united by our drive to get things done. We're proud of our company and our culture - a friendly and inclusive space where we can lift each other up and celebrate our wins every day.
Together, we're setting the bar higher, delivering exceptional work that makes a difference. Our people are the most important part of our story, and everyone here plays a role. There's loads of room to learn and grow, and you'll get the freedom to steer your career wherever you want.
You'll work alongside a talented group who embrace each other's differences and aren't afraid of a challenge. We recognise our achievements, learn from our mistakes, and help each other to be the best we can be. Together, we're making insurance matter.

We believe in the power of AI to meaningfully improve how we work - helping us move faster, think differently, and focus on what matters most. At Zego, we encourage people to stay curious and intentional about how AI is leveraged in their work and teams to drive practical impact every day. This is your chance to do the most meaningful work of your career - and we'll provide you with the tools, support, and freedom to do it well.
How we work

We believe that teams work better when they have time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid.
Our hybrid way of working is unique. We foster a flexible approach that empowers every Zegon to perform at their best. We ask you to spend at least one day a week in our central London office (next to Liverpool Street). We cover the costs for all company-wide events (3 per year), and also provide a separate hybrid contribution to help pay towards other travel costs. We think it's a good mix of collaborative face time and flexible home-working, setting us up to achieve the right balance between work and life.
Benefits

We reward our people well. Join us and you'll get a market-competitive salary, private medical insurance, company share options, generous holiday allowance, and a whole lot of wellbeing benefits. And that's just for starters.

About Stay22

Based in Montreal, Stay22 helps ambitious creators and intent-rich digital platforms turn their existing traffic into incremental revenue, with technology that works quietly in the background.

Today, more than 6,500 creators and platforms rely on Stay22, with over $1 billion in annual transactions flowing through the platform. Originally built for travel, the company now supports partners across retail, lifestyle, publishing, events, and transport as it expands its monetization infrastructure for the modern creator economy.

Position overview

Every creator and platform that works with Stay22 relies on clear, trustworthy data to understand whether their content and traffic are creating value. In this role, you will help make that picture reliable. You will join a small but high-impact Data & Analytics team and work across three squads: Hub, where partners sign up, manage their accounts and track performance; Integrations, which connects supplier and partner data; and Social, which helps creators turn social content into revenue opportunities.

This is a true analytics role, not a position limited to dashboard production. You will turn ambiguous product and business questions into analysis and recommendations, validate data quality and limitations, and help teams make better decisions. You will use SQL, Python, funnels, cohorts, experimentation and dashboards, while bringing curiosity, asking thoughtful questions and owning problems from the first question through to the next step.

Key responsibilities

Partner with Product Managers, engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to support product and business initiatives through data.
Turn unclear questions into clear hypotheses, success metrics and analysis plans.
Support product experiments and A/B tests by validating setup, defining KPIs and analyzing results.
Deliver end-to-end analysis for Hub, Social and Integrations, using funnels, cohorts, segmentation, retention and other practical methods.
Build, maintain and improve dashboards, recurring reports and trusted metrics.
Validate data quality by checking definitions, duplicates, missing events, freshness and differences between sources.
Present findings, limitations and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Help teams become more self-sufficient in using data and interpreting results through documentation, clear definitions and reusable analysis.
Partner with Data Engineering to improve data quality and analytical workflows without owning ETL architecture or infrastructure.

Requirements

At least 5 years of experience in data analytics, product analytics, business intelligence, growth analytics, strategy, insights or a related field.
Strong SQL skills and experience owning analyses from clarifying the question through validation, interpretation and recommendation.
Experience with BI or visualization tools such as Sigma, Looker, Tableau, Power BI or a comparable platform.
Practical Python experience for data cleaning, exploration, automation, prototyping or working with larger datasets.
A solid understanding of statistics, metric definition, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, experimentation and A/B testing.
Strong data-quality judgment, including the ability to identify anomalies, missing events, duplicates, inconsistent definitions and limitations across sources.
Clear communication skills and the ability to turn complex analysis into practical recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Curiosity, autonomy and comfort asking questions, working through ambiguity, adapting to changing priorities and validating AI-assisted analysis when used.

What to expect during our hiring process

We know your time is valuable, here is a quick look at the next steps:

Call with our Talent Acquisition Advisor (30 min).
Interview with the hiring manager (45 min).
Technical interview and live case with members of the Data team and a Product partner (60 min).
Final interview with our CEO (30 min).
Offer and onboarding 🎉

Note: this process may evolve based on the team's needs.

Why join Stay22?

Prime Montreal Location
: Work from our vibrant Little Italy HQ with a cafeteria allowance, full gym access, and a rooftop terrace complete with a seasonal basketball/pickleball court & hockey rink.
Comprehensive Benefits:
Health & dental coverage, RRSP matching, fully paid STM pass’, and regular team socials, events, and retreats.
Flexibility That Works:
Flexible schedules, work-from-anywhere opportunities, year-end shutdown, and flex days.

(Stay22 is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration. If you have a disability or particular need that requires accommodation, please contact us at careers@stay22.com )

Your application will be reviewed by Nayo
, our internal recruiter- even if you don’t meet every requirement but you’re excited, let’s talk.

Analyste senior, opérations de revenus et données GTM

Aperçu du poste

Chaque créateur et chaque plateforme qui travaille avec Stay22 dépend de données claires et fiables pour comprendre si son contenu et son trafic génèrent de la valeur. Dans ce rôle, tu contribueras à rendre cette lecture fiable. Tu rejoindras une équipe Data & Analytics à taille humaine et à fort impact, et tu travailleras avec trois squads : Hub, où les partenaires s’inscrivent, gèrent leur compte et suivent leur performance; Integrations, qui relie les données des fournisseurs et des partenaires; et Social, qui aide les créateurs à transformer leur contenu social en opportunités de revenus.

Il s’agit d’un véritable rôle en analytique, et non d’un poste limité à la création de tableaux de bord. Tu transformeras des questions produit et business ambiguës en analyses et recommandations, tu évalueras la qualité des données et leurs limites, et tu aideras les équipes à prendre de meilleures décisions. Principales responsabilités

Collaborer avec les gestionnaires de produit, les ingénieurs et les parties prenantes de différentes équipes pour soutenir les initiatives produit et d’affaires grâce aux données.
Transformer des questions peu précises en hypothèses claires, indicateurs de succès et plans d’analyse.
Soutenir les expérimentations produit et les tests A/B en validant leur mise en place, en définissant les KPI et en analysant les résultats.
Mener des analyses de bout en bout pour Hub, Social et Integrations, à l’aide d’entonnoirs, de cohortes, de segmentation, de rétention et d’autres méthodes pratiques.

Vérifier la qualité des données en contrôlant les définitions, les doublons, les événements manquants, la fraîcheur des données et les écarts entre les sources.
Présenter clairement les constats, les limites et les recommandations à des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques.
Aider les équipes à devenir plus autonomes dans l’utilisation et l’interprétation des données grâce à une bonne documentation, des définitions claires et des analyses réutilisables.
Collaborer avec Data Engineering pour améliorer la qualité des données et les méthodes d’analyse, sans être responsable de l’architecture ETL ou de l’infrastructure.

Bonne compréhension des statistiques, de la définition des métriques, de l’analyse d’entonnoirs, de l’analyse de cohortes, de l’expérimentation et des tests A/B.
Bon jugement en matière de qualité des données, notamment pour repérer les anomalies, les événements manquants, les doublons, les définitions incohérentes et les limites entre différentes sources.
Excellentes aptitudes de communication et capacité à transformer une analyse complexe en recommandations concrètes pour des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques.
Curiosité, autonomie et aisance à poser des questions, à avancer dans l’ambiguïté, à s’adapter aux priorités changeantes et à valider les analyses assistées par l’IA lorsque nécessaire.

Entrevue finale avec notre PDG (30 min).

Note : ce processus peut évoluer selon les besoins de l'équipe.

Pourquoi rejoindre Stay22?

Emplacement de choix à Montréal :
Travaillez depuis notre dynamique siège social situé dans la Petite-Italie, avec une allocation pour la cafétéria, un accès complet au gym, ainsi qu’une terrasse sur le toit comprenant un terrain saisonnier de basketball/pickleball et une patinoire de hockey.

Couverture santé et dentaire, contribution de l’employeur au REER, titre de transport STM entièrement payé, ainsi que des activités d’équipe, événements et retraites réguliers.

Horaires flexibles, possibilités de travailler de n’importe où, fermeture des bureaux en fin d’année et journées flexibles.

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. Role Overview

Nebius is seeking an experienced Security Analyst - Tier 2 for its Security Operations Center (SOC). This role is a hands-on position built for depth, serving as the investigative core of the SOC, focused on evidence and grounded conclusions. This role reports to the SOC Manager, under the Detection and Response function within the CISO Office.

You are welcome to work in our offices in Tel Aviv, Israel.

Key Responsibilities

Investigate escalated security alerts across endpoint, identity, cloud, email, and network layers.
Determine scope, impact, and root cause using EDR, SIEM, and supporting telemetry.
Escalate suspected incidents to the Incident Response team and complex investigations to Tier 3.
Provide structured feedback to relevant stakeholders on detection or prevention quality, false-positive patterns, and coverage gaps discovered during investigations.
Contribute to and refine SOC runbooks, triage guides, and investigation procedures.
Review Tier 1 escalations, coach on handoff quality, and act as the analytical reference during triage.
Document investigations to a standard that supports handoff, quality review, and lessons learned.
Participate in the on-call rotation, acting as the investigative point of contact outside business hours.

Experience

Required Qualifications:

Around 5-7 years of hands-on security operations experience, with proven depth in alert investigation.
Experience taking investigations to a clear verdict, including confirmed incidents.

Technical Expertise

Strong working command of EDR platforms and SIEM-based investigation, including writing and adapting queries independently.
Solid understanding of attacker techniques, with the ability to map findings to MITRE ATT&CK in analysis and reporting.
Investigation capability across at least two of: endpoint, identity, cloud, email, or network domains.
Windows and Linux internals at the depth required for log and artifact analysis: processes, authentication flows, and persistence mechanisms.
Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, and the ability to interpret network telemetry.
Scripting ability (Python or similar) for analysis at scale, and familiarity with SOAR platforms.
Certifications such as BTL2, OSDA, or CDSA are an advantage.

Leadership & Communication

Intellectual honesty, clearly distinguishing important and vague data, what is known, what is assumed, and what is still unknown.
Collaborative escalation habits, hands off with context and stays available to support what comes next.
Structured written communication, writing investigation notes that tell the story on their own.
Fluent in English, written and verbal, comfortable working with international teams and stakeholders.

Benefits & Perks

Competitive compensation
Career growth and learning opportunities
Flexibility and ownership
Collaborative and innovative culture
Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
International environment and talented teams

What's It Like To Work At Nebius

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

jobs.title: Staff Data Analyst, Marketplace Insights
jobs.description:
About CookUnity

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About The Role

Data Analysts are the people who form a marriage of minds with product, marketing and commercial managers and provide them the insights they need to drive improvements in their products. They explore data, create impactful visualizations and visualization and design and analyze experiments to fuel team learning and innovation. Over time, as both the learning needs and the analysts' understanding of how to address them mature, they build their understanding into self-service insights dashboards that enable learnings to be generated without the direct support of data professionals. This creates the opportunity to go deeper on other areas. It’s a role where mastery in metric setting, visualization, data storytelling, experimentation and partnering come together to facilitate team measurement and learningwithin their daily rhythms.

What You’ll Do In 12 Months

Transform our understanding of how users discover and order food through behavioral insights: Collaborate with Marketplace and Menu teams to understand user behaviors and drivers behind their interactions with our platform. Uncover patterns and trends in menu discovery, evaluation and ordering actions, informing the improvement of the marketplace experience. Success will be measured by the number of insights that have led to improvements in user experience and engagement metrics, resulting in increased customer satisfaction and retention.
Enable self-service insights where you can: Develop intuitive, interactive data visualizations in Tableau that empower stakeholders to easily explore and understand key metrics and trends. Create storytelling narratives within the dashboard that guide users through the data, enabling them to derive actionable insights independently. Success will be measured by the adoption of the dashboard among stakeholders and the frequency of use in decision-making processes, indicating improved data literacy.
Define metrics and customer segments to gain further insights: Define relevant metric frameworks (behavioral and performance) and user segmentations that align to the learning goals of the team. Work with the product teams to prove your segmentations can be used to build more personalized customer experience. Success will be measured by the change in metrics as a result of improved feature targeting, prioritization and personalization.
Help with the product teams scale up early testing and controlled experiments: Design, support execution of and analyze (semi-)controlled experiments. Leverage platforms to enable self-serve conclusions about success, but provide hands on support to understand in-test behaviors. Produce learnings and work closely with user experience researchers to help the product teams understand the why of their successes and failures. Success will be measured by the number of major product features where roll out and full development is evidenced through early testing and light touch experimentation.

● Participant Coordination: Send invitations, schedule sessions, and manage participant communications.
● Session Facilitation: Host sessions, keep discussions on track, and ensure participant engagement.
● Feedback Synthesis: Summarize findings, identify themes, and translate feedback into actionable items for Platform and Science & Engineering.

Business Management Burst Support: Provide flexible, time-bound support for planning, coordination, reporting, stakeholder follow-up, and operational tracking.

Bachelors degree or higher; project management coursework or certification preferred, such as PMP, Six Sigma, Lean, Design Thinking, or Agile.

3–5 years of project management, operations, user research operations, product operations, healthcare, life sciences, or a related field.

Soft Skills

● Feedback actions are visible, owned, and tracked through implementation.

WHY JOIN AGU

Our employees are our most valuable assets! You will feel welcomed and supported from the moment you join our team, and you will take part in strengthening and evolving our workplace culture.

We offer work-life balance and innovative benefits.

Work-life balance: remote-first organization, flexible work hours, unlimited PTO, Flexible Fridays, paid holidays, military leave, parental leave.
Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, life Insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, wellness, tuition reimbursement, 403(b) retirement plan, FSA, HSA, theft protection, personal and professional development, and much more.

Who We Are

The American Geophysical Union (AGU) supports a global community of more than half a million professionals and advocates in the Earth and space sciences.

Through broad and inclusive partnerships, AGU aims to advance discovery and solution science that accelerates knowledge and creates solutions that are ethical, unbiased, and respectful of communities and their values. Our programs include serving as a scholarly publisher, convening virtual and in-person events, and providing career support. We live our values in everything we do, such as our net-zero energy renovated building in Washington, D.C., and our Ethics and Equity Center, which fosters a diverse and inclusive geoscience community to ensure responsible conduct.

This is an exciting time to work at AGU. Every day we approach our work with a sense of purpose, and we look for others who share that passion and desire for a career with impact.

Who You Are

As the Project Manager you will support AGU’s mission to advance Earth and space sciences for the benefit of humanity by planning and delivering projects that meet established scope, schedule, budget, quality, and performance expectations.

You are responsible for coordinating the execution, implementation, and completion of assigned projects. This includes developing project plans, establishing timelines and budgets, identifying resource needs, tracking progress, managing risks and issues, and coordinating the work of cross-functional team members, vendors, and consultants. The Project Manager ensures that project activities remain aligned with organizational priorities and that changes to scope, schedule, or budget are appropriately evaluated, documented, and communicated.

Working collaboratively with project sponsors, customers, and other stakeholders, the Project Manager helps define project objectives, requirements, deliverables, roles, and measures of success. The position facilitates meetings, maintains project documentation, prepares status reports, supports informed decision-making, and escalates significant risks or barriers when necessary.

You will receive general direction and applies established project management practices, policies, and procedures to assigned work. Success in this role requires strong organizational, analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills; sound judgment; attention to detail; and the ability to build productive working relationships, manage competing priorities, and guide teams toward successful project outcomes.

What You Will Do

Manage assigned projects from initiation through completion, applying established PMO processes, tools, and project management practices.

Collaborate with project sponsors, customers, and cross-functional teams to define project scope, objectives, success criteria, requirements, and deliverables.
Identify project stakeholders and develops appropriate communication and engagement approaches to keep them informed and involved throughout the project lifecycle.
Work with sponsors, team members, contractors, and consultants to develop project deliverables, resource requirements, work plans, budgets, schedules, and measures of success.
Develop and maintains project plans, schedules, budgets, communication plans, risk registers, decision logs, status reports, and other required project documentation.
Organize and coordinates project activities, meetings, dependencies, and deliverables to support timely and effective execution.
Monitor project budgets, forecasts expenses, reviews financial performance, and communicates potential budget variances to the project sponsor and appropriate leadership.
Identify project resource needs and works with functional managers and project sponsors to secure the staff, contractors, consultants, and other resources required for successful delivery.
Coordinate the work of cross-functional project teams, contractors, and consultants, ensuring that roles, responsibilities, expectations, and deadlines are clearly understood.
Establish an appropriate schedule and format for project status reporting and provides clear, accurate, and timely updates on progress, accomplishments, risks, issues, decisions, budgets, and upcoming activities.
Monitor project progress against established scope, schedule, budget, quality, and performance requirements and takes corrective action when necessary.
Identify, documents, tracks, and supports the resolution of project risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and barriers, escalating significant concerns when appropriate.
Manage proposed changes to project scope, schedule, budget, resources, or deliverables through established change-control processes.
Develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans to reduce the potential impact of project risks and unexpected challenges.
Assign and coordinates project tasks, follows up on commitments, and promotes accountability among project team members while recognizing that functional managers retain responsibility for employee supervision and performance management.
Facilitate productive project meetings and discussions, helping teams resolve conflicts, make decisions, and maintain progress toward agreed-upon outcomes.
Build collaborative working relationships with project sponsors, team members, customers, vendors, consultants, and other stakeholders who are essential to project success.
Support effective communication and knowledge sharing across teams, departments, and project stakeholders.
Ensure that project deliverables are reviewed, accepted, documented, and transitioned to the appropriate operational owner.
Conduct project closeout activities, including lessons-learned sessions and post-project evaluations, and documents recommendations to improve future project delivery.
Identify and recommends practical improvements to project processes, tools, and approaches in support of PMO and organizational goals.
Perform other duties as required or assigned which are reasonably within the scope of the duties in this job classification.

What You Will Bring

Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred, with 3+ years of experience working in related field or related environment, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
PMP, or industry equivalent preferred.
Thorough understanding of project/program management techniques and methods.
Experience in association management is preferred.
General understanding of project portfolio management concepts.
Knowledge of MS Office; working knowledge of program/project management software (Basecamp, MS Project, Monday.com etc.) is a strong advantage.
Professional interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills.
Leadership, time management, facilitation, emotional intelligence, and organizational skills.
Strong customer service skills.
problem-solving ability
Flexible during times of change; ability to react to project adjustments and alterations promptly and efficiently.
Ability to effectively prioritize and execute projects in a high-pressure environment is crucial.
Ability to read communication styles of team members and contractors who come from a broad spectrum of disciplines.
Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources.
Ability to bring projects to successful completion through political sensitivity.
Confidence and motivation to operate with independence and to take part in senior leadership efforts as needed.
Demonstrated knowledge of key programmatic, operational, financial, and management issues and priorities.
Capable of exercising discretion on both internal and external confidential matters.
Ability to travel

Agu Essential Values

Accountability: Own it.
Excellence: Give your all.
Member & Customer Service: Members & Customers first.
Teamwork: Together everyone achieves more.
Respect-Earn it and give it.
Integrity- Do the right thing.

HIRING SPECIFICS

We understand that it is unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria listed in a job posting. However, we encourage you to apply if you meet many of the requirements because we know that skills evolve. If you are willing to learn and evolve alongside us, join our team!

new_jobs.title: Program Manager - HR Transformation (Fixed-Term Contract, Remote)
new_jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Program Manager who thrives on bringing structure, momentum and clarity to complex transformation? This is an opportunity to play a central role in an enterprise program, helping to coordinate and deliver the people activity initiatives that will support a major technology-enabled transformation across the organisation.

Working closely with the HR Program Lead, HR Talent Lead, HR Leadership Team, workstream delivery teams and HRIT, you will ensure activities are well planned, coordinated, tracked and delivered against clear objectives and timelines. You will be the connective tissue across multiple delivery teams, bringing disciplined execution, strong stakeholder management and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast-moving global environment.

This is an 18-month fixed-term contract and can be a fully remote role, giving you the flexibility to work from anywhere in the UK, with optional office access if desired. As an alternative location, we will also consider candidates based in the US Eastern Time Zone.

The Role

• Partner with workstream delivery teams and project managers to turn transformation objectives into practical delivery plans, milestones and execution roadmaps.
• Build and maintain integrated program plans, milestone trackers, RAID logs, risk registers and status dashboards to provide clear visibility of progress.
• Drive day-to-day program execution, ensuring activities remain aligned to agreed objectives, timelines and outcomes.
• Identify and manage dependencies, constraints, risks and critical path activities, escalating issues with clear recommendations and mitigation options.
• Coordinate across delivery teams to ensure key deliverables are completed on schedule and to agreed quality standards.
• Provide structured updates to program leadership and stakeholders on progress, risks, issues, dependencies and decisions.
• Establish and manage governance cadences, including steering committee reviews, workstream check-ins and escalation protocols.
• Build strong working relationships with HRLT, HRIT, Internal Comms and Change Management, Legal, Finance, AI TMO and functional leaders.
• Ensure HRIT and change management deliverables are integrated into program planning, readiness, training and communications activity.
• Promote best practice program management standards and capture lessons learned to improve future transformation initiatives.
• Ensure the program is aligned to and tracking against the financial goals and targets (investment, savings)

What you’ll bring

• Significant project or program management experience delivering complex global transformation in a large enterprise environment.
• Experience in HR transformation, operating model transformation, technology-enabled change or large-scale business change programs.
• A track record of managing multiple cross-functional projects or workstreams simultaneously, including dependencies, risks and stakeholder expectations.
• Experience supporting executive governance forums and preparing clear, decision-focused leadership reporting materials.
• Strong stakeholder management, facilitation and meeting management skills, with the confidence to drive alignment and decisions in ambiguous environments.
• Structured and disciplined delivery skills, with the ability to translate strategic objectives into practical plans and measurable outcomes.
• Working knowledge of both waterfall and agile or hybrid delivery methodologies.
• An analytical mindset, with confidence using data, metrics and technology to inform decisions and status reporting.
• Practical experience using generative AI tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT or equivalent, to improve productivity, problem-solving and business outcomes.
• A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or MSP is desirable.

What we offer

Enjoy a benefits package designed to help you thrive, both professionally and personally. You'll receive 25 days of annual leave plus an extra WTW day to relax and recharge. Our comprehensive health and wellbeing offering includes private healthcare, life insurance, group income protection, and regular health assessments, all giving you peace of mind. Secure your future with our defined contribution pension scheme, featuring matched contributions up to 10% from the company.

We support your growth and balance with hybrid working options, access to an employee assistance programme, and a fully paid volunteer day to make a difference in your community. On top of these, you can opt into a variety of additional perks including an electric vehicle car scheme, share scheme, cycle-to-work programme, dental and optical cover, critical illness protection, and much more. Start making the most of your career and wellbeing with a range of benefits tailored for you.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidatehelpdesk@wtwco.com

new_jobs.description:
Remote

Full Time

Travel Less than 10%

Job Summary

MAP International is seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our IT team and lead delivery of the projects driving our technology transformation. This role owns planning, coordination, and execution across concurrent initiatives — including cloud migration to AWS, Salesforce CRM implementation, and related systems and process work — keeping scope, schedule, budget, and risk visible to stakeholders at every level. The ideal candidate brings a track record of shipping technology projects on time in a resource-conscious environment, communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical partners, and is enthusiastic about using AI tools to work faster and better. Above all, this person is motivated by the chance to apply strong delivery discipline to a global humanitarian mission.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Project Planning and Execution

Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, and deliverables for concurrent technology and operational initiatives
Define project scope and success criteria with sponsors, and manage change control when scope shifts
Coordinate cross-functional project teams, internal staff, and external vendors to keep work moving against committed dates
Track task ownership, dependencies, and blockers, and drive issues to resolution
Maintain project documentation including charters, status reports, decision logs, and post-implementation reviews

Stakeholder Communication and Reporting

Provide regular status reporting to leadership, translating technical detail into clear business impact
Facilitate project meetings, working sessions, and steering committee updates, and publish decisions and action items
Partner with department leaders to gather requirements, confirm priorities, and manage expectations on timelines and trade-offs
Support change management and end-user readiness activities, including training coordination and communication plans.

Risk, Budget, and Vendor Management

Identify, document, and actively manage project risks, assumptions, and constraints, escalating with recommended options
Track project budgets, forecasts, and actuals in partnership with IT and Finance
Manage vendor and implementation-partner deliverables, statements of work, and timelines
Monitor resource capacity across projects and flag conflicts before they affect delivery

Process Improvement and AI-Enabled Delivery

Establish and improve repeatable project management practices, templates, and reporting standards for the organization
Apply AI tools to routine project work such as drafting status updates, summarizing meetings and documentation, analyzing project data, and automating recurring tasks
Share effective AI practices with colleagues and help identify where AI can reduce manual effort in project and operational workflows
Contribute to continuous improvement of intake, prioritization, and portfolio visibility processes

ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS

This position reports to the Chief Operations and Information Officer and works collaboratively across the organization. Internally, the Project Manager partners with IT team members on technical delivery and release planning, works with program, operations, logistics, development, and finance staff to gather requirements and coordinate project activities, and provides leadership with clear visibility into project status, risk, and resource needs. The role influences and coordinates work across teams without direct supervisory authority and adapts communication for both technical and non-technical audiences. Externally, the Project Manager manages implementation partners, consultants, and technology vendors, coordinates schedules and deliverables with those partners, and may interface with partner organizations such as NGOs and healthcare providers on projects that affect shared systems and data exchange in support of MAP's global medicine distribution mission.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Required Qualifications

Proven experience working in a nonprofit or mission-driven organization
5+ years of experience managing projects end to end, including scope, schedule, budget, risk, and stakeholder communication
Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities and shared resources
Experience leading technology or systems implementation projects, such as platform migrations, CRM or ERP rollouts, or integration work
Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and external vendors without direct supervisory authority
Evidence of using AI tools in day-to-day work, and enthusiasm for applying AI to improve project delivery and team productivity
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting status and risk to executive audiences

Preferred Qualifications

PMP certification
Agile project management experience, including sprint planning, backlog management, and iterative delivery
Hands-on experience administering or working in Jira, including boards, workflows, and reporting dashboards
Agile or Scrum credentials such as CSM, PSM, PMI-ACP, or SAFe
Experience with AWS cloud migration projects or Salesforce CRM implementations
Experience building AI-assisted workflows or automations that reduced manual effort on a team
Experience with Confluence, Smartsheet, Asana, Microsoft Project, or comparable portfolio tools
Experience managing projects with limited budgets and lean staffing
Background in healthcare, pharmaceutical distribution, or international development sectors

Education And/Or Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Project Management, or related field, or equivalent professional experience
5+ years of professional project management experience, including at least 2 years managing technology or systems implementation projects

Other Skills And Abilities

Enter skills that are both jobs related and can be demonstrated in an interview or on a resume. Character traits that are highly subjective should be avoided. Such as good judgement, strong integrity, quick learner. Instead, the manager should list evidence of these characteristics as the requirement i.e. Evidence of learning multiple systems in short periods of time; Experience in positions requiring independent judgement and evidence of success within those roles

Project Management

Project planning, scheduling, and dependency mapping across concurrent workstreams
Scope definition, change control, budget tracking, and risk and issue management
Waterfall and Agile delivery methods, including sprint planning and backlog management
Status reporting and executive-level project communication

Tools and Systems

Jira and Confluence, or comparable work tracking and documentation platforms
Microsoft 365, including Teams, Excel, SharePoint, and Project
Dashboard and report building for project and portfolio visibility

AI and Continuous Improvement

Evidence of using AI assistants to draft documents, summarize meetings and requirements, analyze project data, or automate recurring tasks
Evidence of documenting a manual process and improving it, with measurable time or error reduction
Willingness to test new tools and share what works with colleagues

Communication and Stakeholder Management

Facilitating meetings and driving decisions among stakeholders with competing priorities
Translating technical detail for non-technical audiences and business needs for technical teams
Evidence of holding cross-functional teams accountable to deadlines without direct authority
Experience in positions requiring independent judgement, with evidence of success in those roles

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 5 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 40 pounds. Regular domestic travel is required to represent the program at conferences, churches, and outreach opportunities. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus during significant computer related work. Employee must be able to read, write, and speak English fluently.

new_jobs.description:
Company description

VAULTED AG is a Swiss deep-tech start-up born from research at ETH Zurich and the Empa innovation ecosystem. We combine world-class engineering, computational design, digital fabrication and advanced manufacturing to rethink how buildings are designed and delivered.
Our core technology, the Rippmann Floor System® (RFS)
, reduces structural mass by up to 70%, steel use by up to 90%, and embodied carbon by up to 75% compared with conventional concrete slabs.
As we scale from pioneering projects to repeatable international delivery and commercial growth across Switzerland, Belgium, the UK and the US
, we are looking for an exceptional Project Manager
to take ownership of VAULTED projects once they move from commercial opportunity into execution.

Role description

Your job is simple to describe, but challenging to do exceptionally well: make sure we deliver what we promised.

You will be the central point of contact connecting our customers with VAULTED's engineering, design, operations and commercial teams as well as external suppliers and project partners. You will create structure where there is ambiguity, anticipate problems before they become critical, keep decisions and people moving, and ensure customers feel that their project is in safe hands.
This role requires someone who is highly structured and driven, but equally strong with people
: someone who builds trusted relationships, listens and understands different perspectives, while also being comfortable setting boundaries, challenging constructively and holding people to commitments.

At VAULTED, you'll join a highly international and interdisciplinary team with a strong culture of collaboration, trust and individual ownership. You'll have significant responsibility from day one and help shape not only individual projects, but also how VAULTED delivers projects as we scale.

What you’ll do

Own project delivery:
Lead VAULTED projects from commercial handover through successful delivery, keeping scope, milestones, responsibilities, timelines and quality on track.
Lead the customer relationship:
Be the main point of contact for customers and key project stakeholders. Build trust, manage expectations proactively and handle difficult conversations with clarity and confidence.
Create clarity and momentum:
Turn complex situations into clear decisions, actions, owners and deadlines. Identify risks and bottlenecks early, remove blockers and escalate where needed.
Coordinate teams and partners:
Bring together VAULTED’s engineering, design, operations and commercial teams as well as suppliers and external project partners, ensuring everyone is aligned and moving towards the same goal.
Maintain project control:
Keep a clear overview of project plans, risks, changes, resources and budgets, track project costs and margins, and ensure commercial implications are identified and addressed early.
Improve how we deliver:
Capture lessons from projects and help build better processes, standards and tools as VAULTED scales.

What you’ll bring

Excellent project management:
You have successfully owned complex projects with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities and meaningful customer expectations.
Exceptional ownership and organisation:
You create structure naturally, anticipate what is needed, follow through reliably and make things happen without requiring constant direction.
High empathy and high standards:
You build strong relationships, listen well and understand different perspectives, while also being comfortable setting boundaries, challenging constructively and holding people to commitments.
Strong customer and stakeholder skills:
You communicate clearly and confidently with customers, technical experts, suppliers and senior stakeholders and can influence decisions without formal authority.
Sound judgement:
You can navigate ambiguity, identify what really matters, anticipate risks and know when to solve a problem directly and when to escalate.
Languages and location:
You are fluent in English and German and are based in, or willing to relocate to, the Zurich area. Swiss German is an advantage. The role is primarily based in Dübendorf, with travel to project and construction sites in Switzerland and abroad.

What would make you stand out

Experience in construction, engineering, architecture or another technically complex industry.
Experience delivering physical or engineered products, particularly in prefabrication, structural systems, concrete, timber, façade systems or modular construction.
Experience working directly with architects, engineers, contractors, developers, manufacturers or construction suppliers.
Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment where processes and responsibilities are still evolving.
A strong interest in sustainable construction and technology.

You are successful in this role when:

Customers trust VAULTED and feel informed throughout their project.
Everyone involved knows what needs to happen, who owns it and by when
.
Risks and difficult conversations happen early rather than becoming late surprises.
Decisions are made and followed through.
Scope, budgets and changes remain under control.
Technical experts can focus on solving the right problems rather than chasing coordination.
Projects move forward with pace while maintaining quality.
Each project makes the next one easier to deliver.

What's in for you:

Real ownership:
Take responsibility for highly visible international projects and have a direct influence on their success.
Exceptional learning:
Work closely with leading engineers, architects, contractors, manufacturers and customers at the intersection of technology, sustainability and innovation.
Build, don't just operate:
Help establish the project-management standards, processes and organisation that will enable VAULTED to scale internationally.
Meaningful impact:
Contribute directly to bringing a fundamentally more resource-efficient and circular structural system into mainstream construction.
Strong team culture:
Join an ambitious, highly international and interdisciplinary team built around trust, collaboration and individual ownership.
Growth:
Grow with a deep-tech company moving from breakthrough innovation into international commercial scale.

How to apply:

If you are interested in this role, please get in touch at jobs@vaulted.swiss with your CV,
a brief motivation letter
on your relevant experience, first possible start date and salary expectation.

new_jobs.description:
Senior Project Manager - Delivery Operations & Strategy (SN Digital)

About US

The company

Springer Nature opens the doors to discovery for researchers, educators, clinicians, and other professionals. Every day, around the globe, our imprints, books, journals, platforms, and technology solutions reach millions of people. For over 175 years our brands and imprints have been a trusted source of knowledge to these communities and today, more than ever, we see it as our responsibility to ensure that fundamental knowledge can be found, verified, understood, and used by our communities – enabling them to improve outcomes, make progress, and benefit the generations that follow.

About SN Digital

Over the past few years, Springer Nature has grown rapidly and as a result, the Discipline and Domain structure was introduced in SN Digital, in a matrix fashion. The aim of the Domain structure is to address scalability issues by uniting teams with a similar goal or focus to work together, whilst Disciplines work as Communities of Practise that allow our colleagues to collaborate on developing their craft.

Domains operate as a “network of teams” with a high degree of empowerment, strong communication, and rapid information flow. Teams within the Domain still have the same autonomy and responsibilities but are part of a wider ‘network of teams with a shared responsibility to collaborate and pull in the same direction. The team is not only working towards the betterment of the team’s products or services, but in doing so they are also working towards achieving the goals of the Domain.

Purpose of the Role

We are seeking a Senior Project Manager to manager programmes of work across Delivery Operations and Strategy. This role will focus on initiatives that are aligned with our technology strategy, drive operational excellence, and provide frameworks for teams to deliver effectively and consistently. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in working on complex programmes of work.

You will be responsible for understanding complex projects and working with a cross-functional team to understand business needs aligned to technology solutions. Often this will be working across different domains within SN Digital and must be able to collaborate and align teams towards targeted outcomes.

This role also acts as a bridge between delivery teams and senior leadership. They will ensure that the priorities, resources and expertise of the teams are in line with the organisational goals to deliver successfully across our portfolio.

The job can be based in any of our main Digital locations (London, Lisbon, Berlin, Dordrecht, Pune), and you will work remotely at times with colleagues in many of our global offices including Lisbon, London (UK), Pune (India), Dordrecht (The Netherlands) and Berlin (Germany). Some travel will be required as appropriate.

About You

You’re an experienced project manager who has supported complex, multi-portfolio programmes from start to finish. With over seven years working at programme or portfolio level you know how to work with high-performing, psychologically safe teams that consistently deliver.

You will work collaboratively with solutions architecture, business analysis and senior leadership to ensure roadmaps, budgets and resources are aligned with strategic priorities. You combine strategic vision with operational discipline and are comfortable working at whatever level programmes require, whether it’s with senior executives or delivery teams.

You can communicate effectively, and your approach is collaborative, focuses on unblocking teams and aligning people towards shared goals. You have in-depth knowledge and experience of agile, Lean and hybrid delivery methodologies and can use delivery tooling and dashboards to enhance transparency. Above all, you have a drive to create a culture of continuous improvement to foster teams that learn fast, adapt quickly and deliver outcomes that make a measurable impact.

Project Delivery Excellence

Successfully initiate, plan, govern, and deliver complex cross-domain programmes of work
Establish clear project objectives, success measures, governance structures, milestones, and stakeholder engagement plans for assigned initiatives.
Ensure projects achieve intended business outcomes and realise anticipated benefits beyond implementation.

Proactively identify, assess, escalate, and manage project and portfolio risks before they impact delivery outcomes.
Facilitate timely resolution of issues and competing priorities through structured decision-making.
Embed risk management practices into project and initiative governance.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

Build trusted relationships with business stakeholders, technology leaders, and delivery teams.
Provide clear, concise, and actionable communication that supports informed decision-making.
Maintain stakeholder alignment and buy-in throughout project lifecycles.

Demand & Strategic Planning

Support demand intake, prioritisation, and planning activities to ensure resources are focused on strategic objectives.
Align projects and programmes to strategic priorities and outcomes
Work with sponsors to define clear outcomes, requirements, constraints, and success criteria.

Continuous Improvement & Change

Identify and implement opportunities to improve processes, governance practices, delivery frameworks, and reporting effectiveness.
Champion a culture of continuous improvement and accountability across project teams.
Drive adoption of best practices within SN Digital

What’s expected

First 3 Months — Learn, Establish & Build Credibility

Organisational Understanding

Develop a comprehensive understanding of Springer Nature Digital processes, governance structures, strategic priorities, and key stakeholders.
Understand the current project portfolio, demand pipeline, risks, dependencies, and reporting mechanisms.

Stakeholder Relationships

Establish strong working relationships with sponsors, delivery teams, technology leaders, and business stakeholders.
Become a trusted point of contact for assigned projects and initiatives

Governance & Delivery Foundations

Review existing project governance frameworks, reporting standards, outcomes, and portfolio management processes.
Take ownership of assigned initiatives and establish clear project controls.

Lead multiple projects through planning, execution, governance, and delivery.
Ensure objectives, scope, risks, dependencies, and resources are actively managed.

PMO Effectiveness

Support demand intake and prioritisation activities to increase delivery predictability.

new_jobs.description:
About The Job

Cityside Fiber is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Program Manager – New Market Development
to be an important part of our growing team. This role is responsible for executing the strategic direction for target markets, tracking and managing team priorities and tasking, building cross-functional launch plans, and supporting successful go-to-market execution. Reporting to the Chief Development Officer, this position oversees a team focused on evaluating and launching new market initiatives. The objective of this role is to establish a strategic pipeline of new market growth opportunities, organize team tasks in design, budgeting, project approval and kickoff, while submitting regular reports to the executive team and financial partners. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking, financial acumen, fiber-to-the-home development knowledge, and strong program management skills to deliver scalable and profitable expansion initiatives. You will operate in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment and excel in hitting the Company's objectives.

Responsibilities

Understand Cityside Fiber's core purpose and values and be passionate about what we do.
Help develop and maintain a multi-year FTTH market expansion strategy aligned with company growth objectives.
Build prioritization frameworks to evaluate and sequence new market opportunities.
Oversee business case development, including subscriber forecasts, penetration modeling, capex assumptions, and ROI analysis.
Establish standardized market launch playbooks and governance processes.
Lead annual and quarterly planning cycles for new market development initiatives.
Manage and mentor a team of analysts, coordinators, and project support staff dedicated to new market development.
Provide strategic guidance while ensuring tactical alignment with Engineering, Construction, Finance, Marketing, and Operations.
Facilitate cross-functional alignment meetings to ensure readiness across departments.
Define scope, deliverables, timelines, and KPIs for market development initiatives from new market selection through delivery.
Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and executive summaries to communicate progress and KPI adherence.
Work in and contribute to an atmosphere of trust and integrity with fellow employees to ensure the overall success of Cityside Fiber.

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position. Management reserves the right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities as business needs evolve.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Construction Management, Engineering, or related field.
7+ years of program or project management experience, with 3+ years in the FTTH space.
Proven expertise in budget management, cost tracking, and performance reporting.
Deep understanding of FTTH deployment lifecycle and market selection.
Advanced proficiency in project management tools (MS Project, Primavera, Smartsheet, Asana, Sitetracker, or similar) and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with the ability to multi-task and be highly responsive to internal and external clients.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present financial and performance data to executives and field teams.
Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders.
PMP or equivalent project management certification is a plus.
Self-starter with strong organizational skills and attention to detail; ability to work well under pressure.
Demonstrated highest level of integrity, intellectual honesty, strong work ethic, and intense customer-first mindset.
Takes initiative; plans efficiently while avoiding analysis paralysis.
Consistent effort, intense commitment, and willingness to go above and beyond when needed.
Strong team player who acts like an owner and is ultimately focused on delivering results with high standards.

About Cityside Fiber

Cityside Fiber is on a mission to deliver high-quality, reliable internet
to communities through innovation and a people-first approach. Headquartered in Irvine, CA, we are an emerging telecommunications provider expanding rapidly due to high demand. Our culture is built on innovation, accountability, and trust
, and we seek independent thinkers who want to contribute to something big.

Location

Headquarters in Irvine, CA. [May require travel depending on role.]

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary: $130,000+ annually (dependent on experience)
Company-sponsored medical & dental for employees (Subsidized for dependents)
401(k) with company match
Paid Time Off (PTO), sick leave, and holidays
Growth opportunities & career development programs

Why Cityside Fiber?

Cityside Fiber believes that we all deserve amazing internet! Our core purpose is to create networks that better enable life-changing connectivity in our communities by daring to be different and having our team members put people first all while having fun. We’re building a next-generation internet provider with a focus on innovation, accountability, and trust
. At Cityside Fiber, you’ll work with a passionate team, have room for growth, and make a real impact.

How To Apply

For immediate consideration, submit your resume through our careers site. No phone inquiries, please.

Visit our website at www.citysidefiber.com

Cityside Fiber is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to diversity and inclusion.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Saras Analytics

Saras Analytics is an AI and data analytics firm built for ecommerce and omnichannel brands. We help fast-growing SMBs and mid-market brands turn disconnected, messy data into decisions — covering ingestion, transformation, and consumption, backed by our own products (Daton and IQ) as the data infrastructure underneath every engagement. Our consulting team is built around forward deployed analysts, data scientists, and subject matter experts who sit close to the client and turn data into strategic guidance CXOs act on.
Why Now

Saras is profitable and bootstrapped. We run flat: talent and good ideas move fast here regardless of tenure or title. Right now our Consulting department is scaling fast — more clients, more concurrent engagements, more moving pieces — and leadership needs to see the department's efficiency and health without pulling delivery teams off client work to report on it. A Program Manager joining now builds that operating system from scratch, not inherits it.
The Role

You'll be the single person accountable for internal process compliance across the Consulting department, reporting to the Head of Consulting. This is a one-of-a-kind, individual contributor seat: you carry no client accounts and no direct reports — your product is the department's operating discipline itself. You'll define and own the efficiency and health metrics leadership has asked to see — bugs caught, requirements and BRDs drafted, new features developed, sev1 issues handled — and run the written review rhythm that keeps every internal initiative moving to an outcome. This is not a client-facing role.
The Bar

Compliance that holds without you in the room is the top priority for this role. A metric nobody trusts, or a process people quietly route around, isn't done — the bar is a department whose health leadership can read at any time, from numbers the delivery teams themselves stand behind.
What You'll Own

Understand the machine before you change it.
Map the department's current delivery tools and workflows end to end — how work enters, moves, and ships — so every process you later define fits how delivery actually runs, not how a template says it should.
Define the metrics and processes that answer leadership's visibility asks.
Turn requests like "how healthy is the department?" into a concrete, instrumented metric set — bugs, BRDs drafted, features developed, sev1s handled, and the ones you propose — each with a definition the teams agree to, a source of truth, and a cadence. Then build the lightweight processes that keep those numbers accurate without adding reporting burden.
Run initiative reviews the Amazon way.
Every review starts with the room silently reading a written summary, followed by comments and clarifying questions — no slide theatre, no status meetings that could have been a document. You write sharply, you hold the quality bar on what others write, and you keep the ritual honest: documents exist to drive decisions, not to be graded.
Drive initiatives to outcomes and closure.
An initiative that's "ongoing" for two quarters is failing. Track every internal initiative to a decision, a shipped result, or an explicit kill — and make the closure visible.
Enforce without becoming the person people route around.
Process compliance holds because the teams see the value, not because you're policing them. When a rule creates more friction than signal, fix the rule.

What Winning Looks Like

First 90 days:
you've mapped the delivery workflow end to end, agreed the first version of the metric set with the Head of Consulting, and run your first initiative reviews — written summary, silent read, comments — with the department showing up prepared.
Steady state:
leadership reads the department's efficiency and health from your standing review, not by asking around; every metric has a definition the teams stand behind; and initiatives visibly close — decided, shipped, or killed — instead of lingering.
Who Thrives Here

Any of these backgrounds can get you in the room. Across all of them: 7–10 years of experience, and at least once you've defined — not inherited — an executive-facing metrics system that leadership actually ran on.
You've run programs or operating mechanisms at Amazon or an Amazon-influenced organization — written narratives, business reviews, metrics-driven cadences — and you left with the mechanism, not the pathology.
You've worked in delivery excellence or delivery governance at a premier consulting firm or large services firm — process compliance, KPI systems, governance forums — and you want your recommendations implemented, not filed in a deck.
You've been a Business Operations / Strategy & Operations individual contributor at a strong Indian tech startup, owning a department's operating cadence, metrics, and OKR system.
You're a Technical Program Manager from a product or engineering organization who lives on sev metrics, bug counts, and release governance — and doesn't need a team reporting to you to have impact.
You have enough delivery-domain fluency to argue with a senior delivery lead about what counts as a sev1 or an adequate BRD — these metrics are not abstractions to you.

It's an even stronger fit if you also bring:

You write to drive decisions — narratives, business cases, review documents — and you're comfortable proving it: we interview in the same format the role runs, starting from a written sample.
You've enforced a standard on people senior to you, and can tell the story of where it held and where it failed — you know how to hold a bar without becoming the person people route around.
You moved from client-facing consulting (analytics or tech) into an internal operating seat — and stayed, because the leverage is real.
You can show 2–3 initiatives you personally drove to closure with a before/after metric delta — not tracked, driven.

Hands-on fluency with delivery tooling (ClickUp, Jira, or similar) and AI tools like Claude to automate the reporting so the humans only do the judgment.

Position Summary
The Client Success Program Manager combines client success, project management, program governance, and service coordination for complex client engagements involving projects, service workstreams, operational activities, third-party resources, and managed services.

This role serves as both the primary Client Success lead and project manager for assigned engagements unless additional support is added based on scale or complexity. It maintains alignment between client objectives, Encore commitments, delivery execution, operational readiness, financial coordination, and ongoing support expectations.

This is not an Account Management or sales role. The Account Manager owns the account relationship, commercial activity, renewals, and overall account strategy. Delivery resources continue to report through their respective service towers and functional leadership.

Key Responsibilities
· Serve as the primary client-facing point of coordination and project manager for assigned complex or strategic engagements.
· Document client objectives, contractual commitments, expected outcomes, governance needs, and measures of success.
· Maintain an integrated view of project, professional services, managed services, operational, financial, and supporting service tower activities.
· Manage project scope, schedules, milestones, budgets, deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, resources, and success criteria.
· Coordinate work across engineers, managed services teams, operational groups, subject matter experts, third-party partners, subcontractors, and client stakeholders.
· Maintain project plans, status reports, action registers, decision logs, risk and issue registers, milestone trackers, dependency logs, and governance documentation.
· Monitor delivery progress against approved scope, schedule, budget, milestones, contractual commitments, and client expectations.
· Identify, document, and manage risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, scope changes, decisions, and escalations.
· Facilitate project status meetings, program reviews, service delivery reviews, executive briefings, and steering committee meetings.
· Provide clear client and internal communication regarding delivery status, risks, decisions, service impacts, financial considerations, schedule changes, and escalations.
· Partner with subject matter experts for technical guidance while retaining responsibility for project structure, governance, communication, coordination, and follow-through.
· Lead service delivery reviews and convert findings into documented actions, accountable owners, expected outcomes, and improvement activities.
· Maintain visibility into client health, service quality, delivery performance, service adoption, and overall engagement health.
· Coordinate monthly invoicing inputs with Service Operations, delivery teams, service leaders, and Finance.
· Monitor project budgets, financial attainment, forecasts, and material variances, escalating concerns as needed.
· Coordinate transitions between implementation, project delivery, hypercare, operational support, and managed services.
· Develop transition plans covering operational readiness, documentation, knowledge transfer, service ownership, support boundaries, escalation paths, governance, and acceptance criteria.
· Identify client concerns, service gaps, delivery risks, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities and coordinate response plans.
· Support vendor-sponsored programs, required client adoption activities, and related outcome tracking.
· Provide appropriate client and delivery insight to Account Management and internal stakeholders without owning sales or commercial activity.
· Achieve and maintain vendor-based certifications as required and perform other related duties as business needs evolve.

Required Qualifications
· Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Project Management, or a related field is desirable, or equivalent professional experience.
· PMP certification required.
